name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.eq_halfInt_of_re_im
statement:
private lemma eq_halfInt_of_re_im
    (d a' b' : ℤ) {x : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)}
    (hre : x.re = (a' : ℚ) / 2) (him : x.im = (b' : ℚ) / 2) :
    x = Zsqrtd.halfInt (d := d) a' b'
proof:
:= by
  ext <;> simp [Zsqrtd.halfInt, hre, him]

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.int_norm_eq_norm_halfInt
statement:
private lemma int_norm_eq_norm_halfInt
    (d a' b' n' : ℤ) {x : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)}
    (hxHalf : x = Zsqrtd.halfInt (d := d) a' b')
    (hn'norm : (n' : ℚ) = Qsqrtd.norm x) :
    (n' : ℚ) = (((a' ^ 2 - d * b' ^ 2 : ℤ) : ℚ) / (4 : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (n' : ℚ) = Qsqrtd.norm x := hn'norm
    _ = Qsqrtd.norm (Zsqrtd.halfInt (d := d) a' b') := by simp [hxHalf]
    _ = (a' ^ 2 - (d : ℚ) * b' ^ 2) / 4 := norm_halfInt d a' b'
    _ = (((a' ^ 2 - d * b' ^ 2 : ℤ) : ℚ) / (4 : ℤ)) := by norm_num

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.dvd_four_sub_sq_of_int_norm_halfInt
statement:
private lemma dvd_four_sub_sq_of_int_norm_halfInt
    (d a' b' n' : ℤ) {x : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)}
    (hxHalf : x = Zsqrtd.halfInt (d := d) a' b')
    (hn'norm : (n' : ℚ) = Qsqrtd.norm x) :
    (4 : ℤ) ∣ (a' ^ 2 - d * b' ^ 2)
proof:
:=
  TraceNorm.dvd_four_sub_sq_of_norm_eq_int a' b' d n'
    (int_norm_eq_norm_halfInt d a' b' n' hxHalf hn'norm)

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.exists_halfInt_with_div_four_of_isIntegral
statement:
@[nolint unusedArguments]
lemma exists_halfInt_with_div_four_of_isIntegral
    (d : ℤ) (hd_sf : Squarefree d) (_hd_ne : d ≠ 1)
    {x : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)} (hx : IsIntegral ℤ x) :
    ∃ a' b' : ℤ,
      x = Zsqrtd.halfInt (d := d) a' b' ∧
      (4 : ℤ) ∣ (a' ^ 2 - d * b' ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a', ha'trace⟩ := TraceNorm.exists_int_trace hx
  obtain ⟨n', hn'norm⟩ := TraceNorm.exists_int_norm hx
  obtain ⟨b', him⟩ := TraceNorm.exists_int_double_im d hd_sf ha'trace hn'norm
  have hxHalf : x = Zsqrtd.halfInt (d := d) a' b' :=
    eq_halfInt_of_re_im d a' b'
      (TraceNorm.re_eq_half_trace_int ha'trace) him
  exact ⟨a', b', hxHalf, dvd_four_sub_sq_of_int_norm_halfInt d a' b' n' hxHalf hn'norm⟩

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.exists_intModel_of_isIntegral
statement:
private lemma exists_intModel_of_isIntegral
    (d : ℤ) (hd_sf : Squarefree d) (hd_ne : d ≠ 1)
    (R : Type*) [CommRing R]
    (φ : R →+* Qsqrtd (d : ℚ))
    (h_lift :
      ∀ a' b' : ℤ, 4 ∣ (a' ^ 2 - d * b' ^ 2) →
        ∃ z : R, φ z = Zsqrtd.halfInt (d := d) a' b')
    {x : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)} (hx : IsIntegral ℤ x) :
    ∃ z : R, φ z = x
proof:
:= by
  
  
  rcases exists_halfInt_with_div_four_of_isIntegral d hd_sf hd_ne (x := x) hx with
    ⟨a', b', hxHalf, hdiv⟩
  rcases h_lift a' b' hdiv with ⟨z, hz⟩
  exact ⟨z, by simpa [hxHalf] using hz⟩

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.exists_zsqrtd_of_isIntegral_of_ne_one_mod_four
statement:
lemma exists_zsqrtd_of_isIntegral_of_ne_one_mod_four
    (d : ℤ) (hd_sf : Squarefree d) (hd_ne : d ≠ 1) (hd4 : d % 4 ≠ 1)
    {x : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)} (hx : IsIntegral ℤ x) :
    ∃ z : Zsqrtd d, Zsqrtd.toQsqrtdHom d z = x
proof:
:=
  exists_intModel_of_isIntegral d hd_sf hd_ne (Zsqrtd d) (Zsqrtd.toQsqrtdHom d)
    (fun a' b' hdiv =>
      exists_zsqrtd_image_of_dvd_four_sub_sq_of_ne_one_mod_four d a' b' hd_sf hd4 hdiv)
    hx

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.exists_zOnePlusSqrtOverTwo_of_isIntegral_of_one_mod_four
statement:
lemma exists_zOnePlusSqrtOverTwo_of_isIntegral_of_one_mod_four
    (k : ℤ) (hd_sf : Squarefree (1 + 4 * k)) (hd_ne : (1 + 4 * k) ≠ 1)
    {x : Qsqrtd (((1 + 4 * k : ℤ) : ℚ))} (hx : IsIntegral ℤ x) :
    ∃ z : ZOnePlusSqrtdOverTwo k, _root_.ZOnePlusSqrtdOverTwo.toQsqrtdHom k z = x
proof:
:=
  exists_intModel_of_isIntegral (1 + 4 * k) hd_sf hd_ne (ZOnePlusSqrtdOverTwo k)
    (_root_.ZOnePlusSqrtdOverTwo.toQsqrtdHom k)
    (fun a' b' hdiv =>
      exists_zOnePlusSqrtOverTwo_image_of_dvd_four_sub_sq_of_one_mod_four k a' b' hd_sf hdiv)
    hx

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.ringOfIntegers_equiv_zsqrtd_of_mod_four_ne_one_apply
statement:
lemma ringOfIntegers_equiv_zsqrtd_of_mod_four_ne_one_apply (hd4 : d % 4 ≠ 1)
    (α : 𝓞 (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ))) :
    Zsqrtd.toQsqrtdHom d (ringOfIntegers_equiv_zsqrtd_of_mod_four_ne_one d hd4 α)
      = (α : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ))
proof:
:=
  ringOfIntegers_equiv_of_embedding_apply (Zsqrtd.toQsqrtdHom d)
    (Zsqrtd.toQsqrtdHom_injective d)
    (fun _ hx => exists_zsqrtd_of_isIntegral_of_ne_one_mod_four d Fact.out Fact.out hd4 hx)
    (fun z => isIntegral_toQsqrtd d z) α

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.ringOfIntegers_equiv_zOnePlusSqrtOverTwo_of_eq_apply
statement:
lemma ringOfIntegers_equiv_zOnePlusSqrtOverTwo_of_eq_apply
    (k : ℤ) [Fact (Squarefree (1 + 4 * k))] [Fact ((1 + 4 * k) ≠ 1)]
    (α : 𝓞 (Qsqrtd (((1 + 4 * k : ℤ) : ℚ)))) :
    ZOnePlusSqrtdOverTwo.toQsqrtdHom k
        (ringOfIntegers_equiv_zOnePlusSqrtOverTwo_of_eq (1 + 4 * k) k rfl α) =
      (α : Qsqrtd (((1 + 4 * k : ℤ) : ℚ)))
proof:
:= by
  unfold ringOfIntegers_equiv_zOnePlusSqrtOverTwo_of_eq
  rw [ringOfIntegers_equiv_of_embedding_apply]

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.ringOfIntegers_equiv_zOnePlusSqrtOverTwo_of_eq_re
statement:
theorem ringOfIntegers_equiv_zOnePlusSqrtOverTwo_of_eq_re
    (k : ℤ) (hk : d = 1 + 4 * k) (α : 𝓞 (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ))) :
    let e
proof:
:= ringOfIntegers_equiv_zOnePlusSqrtOverTwo_of_eq d k hk
    ((e α).re : ℚ) + ((e α).im : ℚ) / 2 = (α : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)).re := by
  subst hk
  simpa using congrArg QuadraticAlgebra.re
    (ringOfIntegers_equiv_zOnePlusSqrtOverTwo_of_eq_apply k α)

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.ringOfIntegers_equiv_zOnePlusSqrtOverTwo_of_eq_im
statement:
theorem ringOfIntegers_equiv_zOnePlusSqrtOverTwo_of_eq_im
    (k : ℤ) (hk : d = 1 + 4 * k) (α : 𝓞 (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ))) :
    let e
proof:
:= ringOfIntegers_equiv_zOnePlusSqrtOverTwo_of_eq d k hk
    ((e α).im : ℚ) / 2 = (α : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)).im := by
  subst hk
  simpa using congrArg QuadraticAlgebra.im
    (ringOfIntegers_equiv_zOnePlusSqrtOverTwo_of_eq_apply k α)

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.ringOfIntegers_equiv_zOnePlusSqrtOverTwo_of_mod_four_eq_one_re
statement:
theorem ringOfIntegers_equiv_zOnePlusSqrtOverTwo_of_mod_four_eq_one_re
    (hd4 : d % 4 = 1) (α : 𝓞 (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ))) :
    let e
proof:
:= ringOfIntegers_equiv_zOnePlusSqrtOverTwo_of_mod_four_eq_one d hd4
    ((e α).re : ℚ) + ((e α).im : ℚ) / 2 = (α : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)).re :=
  ringOfIntegers_equiv_zOnePlusSqrtOverTwo_of_eq_re d (d / 4) (by omega) α

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.ringOfIntegers_equiv_zOnePlusSqrtOverTwo_of_mod_four_eq_one_im
statement:
theorem ringOfIntegers_equiv_zOnePlusSqrtOverTwo_of_mod_four_eq_one_im
    (hd4 : d % 4 = 1) (α : 𝓞 (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ))) :
    let e
proof:
:= ringOfIntegers_equiv_zOnePlusSqrtOverTwo_of_mod_four_eq_one d hd4
    ((e α).im : ℚ) / 2 = (α : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)).im :=
  ringOfIntegers_equiv_zOnePlusSqrtOverTwo_of_eq_im d (d / 4) (by omega) α

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.ringOfIntegers_classification
statement:
theorem ringOfIntegers_classification :
    (d % 4 ≠ 1 ∧
      Nonempty (𝓞 (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) ≃+* Zsqrtd d)) ∨
    (∃ k : ℤ, d = 1 + 4 * k ∧
      Nonempty (𝓞 (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) ≃+* ZOnePlusSqrtdOverTwo k))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hd4 : d % 4 = 1
  · exact Or.inr ⟨d / 4, by omega,
      ⟨ringOfIntegers_equiv_zOnePlusSqrtOverTwo_of_mod_four_eq_one d hd4⟩⟩
  · exact Or.inl ⟨hd4, ⟨ringOfIntegers_equiv_zsqrtd_of_mod_four_ne_one d hd4⟩⟩

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.ringOfIntegers_classification_of_ringEquiv_qsqrtd
statement:
theorem ringOfIntegers_classification_of_ringEquiv_qsqrtd
    {K : Type*} [Field K] (e : K ≃+* Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) :
    (d % 4 ≠ 1 ∧ Nonempty (𝓞 K ≃+* Zsqrtd d)) ∨
    (∃ k : ℤ, d = 1 + 4 * k ∧ Nonempty (𝓞 K ≃+* ZOnePlusSqrtdOverTwo k))
proof:
:= by
  let e𝓞 : 𝓞 K ≃+* 𝓞 (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) :=
    e.ringOfIntegers
  rcases ringOfIntegers_classification d with h | h
  · exact Or.inl ⟨h.1, h.2.map (fun f => e𝓞.trans f)⟩
  · rcases h with ⟨k, hk, hnonempty⟩
    exact Or.inr ⟨k, hk, hnonempty.map (fun f => e𝓞.trans f)⟩

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.exists_ringOfIntegers_classification_of_quadraticField
statement:
theorem exists_ringOfIntegers_classification_of_quadraticField
    (K : Type*) [Field K] [Algebra ℚ K] [QuadraticField K] :
    ∃ d : ℤ, Squarefree d ∧ d ≠ 1 ∧
      ((d % 4 ≠ 1 ∧ Nonempty (𝓞 K ≃+* Zsqrtd d)) ∨
      (∃ k : ℤ, d = 1 + 4 * k ∧ Nonempty (𝓞 K ≃+* ZOnePlusSqrtdOverTwo k)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd_sf, hd_ne, ⟨e⟩⟩ := exists_ringEquiv_qsqrtd K
  letI : Fact (Squarefree d) := ⟨hd_sf⟩
  letI : Fact (d ≠ 1) := ⟨hd_ne⟩
  exact ⟨d, hd_sf, hd_ne, ringOfIntegers_classification_of_ringEquiv_qsqrtd d e⟩

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.discr_zsqrtd_basis
statement:
theorem discr_zsqrtd_basis (d : ℤ) :
    Algebra.discr ℤ (QuadraticAlgebra.basis d 0 :
      Module.Basis (Fin 2) ℤ (Zsqrtd d)) = 4 * d
proof:
:= by
  rw [QuadraticAlgebra.discr_basis_int]
  ring

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.discr_zOnePlusSqrtOverTwo_basis
statement:
theorem discr_zOnePlusSqrtOverTwo_basis (k : ℤ) :
    Algebra.discr ℤ (QuadraticAlgebra.basis k 1 :
      Module.Basis (Fin 2) ℤ (ZOnePlusSqrtdOverTwo k)) = 1 + 4 * k

:= by

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.discrFormula_of_mod_four_eq_one
statement:
theorem discrFormula_of_mod_four_eq_one {d : ℤ} (hd : d % 4 = 1) :
    discrFormula d = d
proof:
:= by
  simp [discrFormula, hd]

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.discrFormula_of_mod_four_ne_one
statement:
theorem discrFormula_of_mod_four_ne_one {d : ℤ} (hd : d % 4 ≠ 1) :
    discrFormula d = 4 * d
proof:
:= by
  simp [discrFormula, hd]

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.discrFormula_emod_four_eq_zero_or_one
statement:
theorem discrFormula_emod_four_eq_zero_or_one (d : ℤ) :
    discrFormula d % 4 = 0 ∨ discrFormula d % 4 = 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : d % 4 = 1
  · right
    rw [discrFormula_of_mod_four_eq_one h]
    exact h
  · left
    rw [discrFormula_of_mod_four_ne_one h, Int.mul_emod_right]

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.discrFormula_odd_iff_mod_four_eq_one
statement:
theorem discrFormula_odd_iff_mod_four_eq_one (d : ℤ) :
    discrFormula d % 2 ≠ 0 ↔ d % 4 = 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hodd
    by_contra hd4
    rw [discrFormula_of_mod_four_ne_one hd4] at hodd
    exact hodd (by omega)
  · intro hd4
    rw [discrFormula_of_mod_four_eq_one hd4]
    omega

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.discr_of_mod_four_ne_one
statement:
theorem discr_of_mod_four_ne_one (hd4 : d % 4 ≠ 1) :
    NumberField.discr (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) = 4 * d
proof:
:= by
  let e := ringOfIntegers_equiv_zsqrtd_of_mod_four_ne_one d hd4
  let f : Zsqrtd d ≃ₐ[ℤ] 𝓞 (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) :=
    ringEquivToIntAlgEquiv e.symm
  let b' : Module.Basis (Fin 2) ℤ (𝓞 (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ))) :=
    (QuadraticAlgebra.basis d 0).map f.toLinearEquiv
  rw [← NumberField.discr_eq_discr (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) b']
  change Algebra.discr ℤ (⇑f ∘ ⇑(QuadraticAlgebra.basis d 0)) = 4 * d
  rw [← Algebra.discr_eq_discr_of_algEquiv _ f]
  exact discr_zsqrtd_basis d

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.discr_of_mod_four_eq_one
statement:
theorem discr_of_mod_four_eq_one (hd4 : d % 4 = 1) :
    NumberField.discr (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) = d
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_k_of_mod_four_eq_one hd4
  subst hk
  let e := ringOfIntegers_equiv_zOnePlusSqrtOverTwo_of_eq (1 + 4 * k) k rfl
  let f : ZOnePlusSqrtdOverTwo k ≃ₐ[ℤ] 𝓞 (Qsqrtd (((1 + 4 * k : ℤ) : ℚ))) :=
    ringEquivToIntAlgEquiv e.symm
  let b' : Module.Basis (Fin 2) ℤ (𝓞 (Qsqrtd (((1 + 4 * k : ℤ) : ℚ)))) :=
    (QuadraticAlgebra.basis k 1).map f.toLinearEquiv
  rw [← NumberField.discr_eq_discr (Qsqrtd (((1 + 4 * k : ℤ) : ℚ))) b']
  change Algebra.discr ℤ (⇑f ∘ ⇑(QuadraticAlgebra.basis k 1)) = 1 + 4 * k
  rw [← Algebra.discr_eq_discr_of_algEquiv _ f]
  exact discr_zOnePlusSqrtOverTwo_basis k

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.discr_formula
statement:
theorem discr_formula :
    NumberField.discr (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) = discrFormula d
proof:
:= by
  unfold discrFormula
  split
  · exact discr_of_mod_four_eq_one d ‹_›
  · exact discr_of_mod_four_ne_one d ‹_›

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.discr_formula_of_algEquiv_qsqrtd
statement:
theorem discr_formula_of_algEquiv_qsqrtd
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [Algebra ℚ K] [NumberField K]
    (e : K ≃ₐ[ℚ] Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) :
    NumberField.discr K = discrFormula d
proof:
:= by
  calc
    NumberField.discr K = NumberField.discr (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) :=
      NumberField.discr_eq_of_algEquiv e
    _ = discrFormula d := discr_formula d

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.exists_discr_formula_of_quadraticField
statement:
theorem exists_discr_formula_of_quadraticField
    (K : Type*) [Field K] [Algebra ℚ K] [QuadraticField K] :
    ∃ d : ℤ, Squarefree d ∧ d ≠ 1 ∧
      NumberField.discr K = discrFormula d
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd_sf, hd_ne, ⟨e⟩⟩ := exists_ringEquiv_qsqrtd K
  letI : Fact (Squarefree d) := ⟨hd_sf⟩
  letI : Fact (d ≠ 1) := ⟨hd_ne⟩
  refine ⟨d, hd_sf, hd_ne, ?_⟩
  calc
    NumberField.discr K = NumberField.discr (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) :=
      NumberField.discr_eq_discr_of_ringEquiv K e
    _ = discrFormula d := discr_formula d

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.discr_gaussian
statement:
theorem discr_gaussian :
    NumberField.discr (Qsqrtd ((-1 : ℤ) : ℚ)) = -4

:=
  discr_of_mod_four_ne_one (-1) (by decide)

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.discr_Qsqrtd_neg_five

  discr_of_mod_four_ne_one (-5) (by decide)

name: QuadraticNumberFields.coe_conjAutRingOfIntegers_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_conjAutRingOfIntegers_apply (x : OK) :
    (conjAutRingOfIntegers K x : K) = QuadraticField.conjAut K x
proof:
:= by

  rfl

name: QuadraticNumberFields.coe_conjAutRingOfIntegersAlgEquiv_apply

name: QuadraticNumberFields.galRestrict_conjAut_eq_conjAutRingOfIntegers
statement:
theorem galRestrict_conjAut_eq_conjAutRingOfIntegers [NumberField K] :

      conjAutRingOfIntegersAlgEquiv K
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simpa [conjAutRingOfIntegersAlgEquiv, coe_conjAutRingOfIntegers_apply] using
    (algebraMap_galRestrict_apply (A := ℤ) (QuadraticField.conjAut K) x)

name: QuadraticNumberFields.conjAutRingOfIntegersAlgEquiv_ne_refl
statement:
theorem conjAutRingOfIntegersAlgEquiv_ne_refl [NumberField K] :
    conjAutRingOfIntegersAlgEquiv K ≠ AlgEquiv.refl
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply QuadraticField.Conj.conj_ne_refl (K := K)
  exact (galRestrict ℤ ℚ K OK).injective <| by

name: QuadraticNumberFields.conjAutFractionRingAlgEquiv_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem conjAutFractionRingAlgEquiv_algebraMap (x : OK) :
    conjAutFractionRingAlgEquiv K
        (algebraMap OK (FractionRing OK) x) =
      algebraMap OK (FractionRing OK) ((conjAutRingOfIntegers K) x)
proof:
:= by
  simp [conjAutFractionRingAlgEquiv, conjAutRingOfIntegersAlgEquiv]

name: QuadraticNumberFields.fractionRing_algEquiv_conjAutFractionRingAlgEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fractionRing_algEquiv_conjAutFractionRingAlgEquiv [NumberField K]
    (z : FractionRing OK) :
    FractionRing.algEquiv OK K
        ((conjAutFractionRingAlgEquiv K) z) =
      QuadraticField.conjAut K
        (FractionRing.algEquiv OK K z)
proof:
:= by
  let R := OK
  have hhom :
      ((FractionRing.algEquiv R K).toRingHom.comp
          (conjAutFractionRingAlgEquiv K).toRingHom) =
        ((QuadraticField.conjAut K).toRingHom.comp
          (FractionRing.algEquiv R K).toRingHom) := by
    apply IsFractionRing.ringHom_ext (A := R) (K := FractionRing R) (L := K)
    intro x
    simp [R, RingHom.comp_apply, coe_conjAutRingOfIntegers_apply]
  exact RingHom.congr_fun hhom z

name: QuadraticNumberFields.conjAutFractionRingAlgEquiv_apply_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem conjAutFractionRingAlgEquiv_apply_apply [NumberField K] (z : FractionRing OK) :
    (conjAutFractionRingAlgEquiv K) ((conjAutFractionRingAlgEquiv K) z) = z
proof:
:=
  (FractionRing.algEquiv OK K).injective (by
    rw [fractionRing_algEquiv_conjAutFractionRingAlgEquiv,
      fractionRing_algEquiv_conjAutFractionRingAlgEquiv]
    exact QuadraticField.Conj.conj_conj (K := K) (FractionRing.algEquiv OK K z))

name: QuadraticNumberFields.exists_mul_conjAutRingOfIntegers_eq_self_of_norm_eq_one
statement:
theorem exists_mul_conjAutRingOfIntegers_eq_self_of_norm_eq_one
    (K : Type) [Field K] [NumberField K] [Algebra ℚ K]
    [QuadraticField K] [QuadraticField.Conj K]
    {η : NumberField.RingOfIntegers K}
    (hη : Algebra.norm ℚ (η : K) = 1) :
    ∃ ε : NumberField.RingOfIntegers K, ε ≠ 0 ∧
      η * (conjAutRingOfIntegers K) ε = ε
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsGalois ℚ K := Algebra.IsQuadraticExtension.isGalois ℚ K
  have hcard : Nat.card Gal(K / ℚ) = 2 := QuadraticField.card_aut_eq_two K
  haveI : IsCyclic Gal(K / ℚ) := isCyclic_of_prime_card hcard
  have hconj_ne_one : (QuadraticField.conjAut K : Gal(K / ℚ)) ≠ 1 := by
    change QuadraticField.conjAut K ≠ AlgEquiv.refl
    exact QuadraticField.Conj.conj_ne_refl (K := K)
  have hg : ∀ σ : Gal(K / ℚ), σ ∈ Subgroup.zpowers (QuadraticField.conjAut K) := by
    intro σ
    exact mem_zpowers_of_prime_card (p := 2) hcard hconj_ne_one
  obtain ⟨ε, hε0, hε⟩ :=
    groupCohomology.exists_mul_galRestrict_of_norm_eq_one
      (A := ℤ) (K := ℚ) (L := K) (B := NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)
      (g := QuadraticField.conjAut K) hg (by simpa using hη)
  refine ⟨ε, hε0, ?_⟩
  change η * (conjAutRingOfIntegersAlgEquiv K) ε = ε
  simpa [galRestrict_conjAut_eq_conjAutRingOfIntegers K] using hε

name: QuadraticNumberFields.exists_conjAut_coboundary_of_norm_eq_one
statement:
theorem exists_conjAut_coboundary_of_norm_eq_one
    (K : Type) [Field K] [NumberField K] [Algebra ℚ K]
    [QuadraticField K] [QuadraticField.Conj K]
    {x : (FractionRing (𝓞 K))ˣ}
    (hxnorm :
      Algebra.norm ℚ
        (FractionRing.algEquiv (𝓞 K) K
          (x : FractionRing (𝓞 K))) = 1) :
    ∃ y : (FractionRing (𝓞 K))ˣ,
      x = y * (Units.mapEquiv (conjAutFractionRingAlgEquiv K).toRingEquiv y)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let R := 𝓞 K
  let e := FractionRing.algEquiv R K
  haveI : IsGalois ℚ K := Algebra.IsQuadraticExtension.isGalois ℚ K
  have hcard : Nat.card Gal(K / ℚ) = 2 := QuadraticField.card_aut_eq_two K
  haveI : IsCyclic Gal(K / ℚ) := isCyclic_of_prime_card hcard
  have hconj_ne_one : (QuadraticField.conjAut K : Gal(K / ℚ)) ≠ 1 := by
    change QuadraticField.conjAut K ≠ AlgEquiv.refl
    exact QuadraticField.Conj.conj_ne_refl (K := K)
  have hg : ∀ σ : Gal(K / ℚ), σ ∈ Subgroup.zpowers (QuadraticField.conjAut K) :=
    fun σ ↦ mem_zpowers_of_prime_card (p := 2) hcard hconj_ne_one
  obtain ⟨yK, hyK⟩ :=
    groupCohomology.exists_div_of_norm_eq_one
      (K := ℚ) (L := K) (g := QuadraticField.conjAut K) hg hxnorm
  let y : (FractionRing R)ˣ := Units.mapEquiv e.symm.toRingEquiv yK
  refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
  apply Units.ext
  apply e.injective
  have hy_map : e (y : FractionRing R) = (yK : K) := by
    change e (e.symm (yK : K)) = (yK : K)
    exact e.apply_symm_apply (yK : K)
  have hσ_map :
      e (((Units.mapEquiv (conjAutFractionRingAlgEquiv K).toRingEquiv y) :
          (FractionRing R)ˣ) : FractionRing R) =
        QuadraticField.conjAut K (yK : K) := by
    change e ((conjAutFractionRingAlgEquiv K) (y : FractionRing R)) =
      QuadraticField.conjAut K (yK : K)
    rw [fractionRing_algEquiv_conjAutFractionRingAlgEquiv, hy_map]
  calc
    e (x : FractionRing R) = (yK : K) / QuadraticField.conjAut K (yK : K) := hyK.symm
    _ =
        e (y : FractionRing R) *
            (e (((Units.mapEquiv (conjAutFractionRingAlgEquiv K).toRingEquiv y) :
              (FractionRing R)ˣ) : FractionRing R))⁻¹ := by
      rw [hy_map, hσ_map]
      exact div_eq_mul_inv (yK : K) (QuadraticField.conjAut K (yK : K))
    _ = e ((y * (Units.mapEquiv (conjAutFractionRingAlgEquiv K).toRingEquiv y)⁻¹ :
          (FractionRing R)ˣ) : FractionRing R) := by
      dsimp
      simp

name: QuadraticNumberFields.galRestrict_conjAutFractionRingGal
statement:
theorem galRestrict_conjAutFractionRingGal [NumberField K] :
    galRestrict ℤ (FractionRing ℤ) (FractionRing OK) OK

proof:

name: QuadraticNumberFields.conjAutFractionRingGal_ne_one
statement:
theorem conjAutFractionRingGal_ne_one [NumberField K] :
    conjAutFractionRingGal K ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro hτ
  apply conjAutRingOfIntegersAlgEquiv_ne_refl (K := K)
  have h := congrArg
    (galRestrict ℤ (FractionRing ℤ) (FractionRing OK) OK) hτ
  rw [galRestrict_conjAutFractionRingGal, map_one] at h
  change conjAutRingOfIntegersAlgEquiv K = AlgEquiv.refl
  exact h

name: QuadraticNumberFields.conjAutFractionRingGal_smul_ideal
statement:
theorem conjAutFractionRingGal_smul_ideal [NumberField K] (I : Ideal OK) :
    conjAutFractionRingGal K • I =
      Ideal.map (conjAutRingOfIntegers K : OK →+* OK) I
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.pointwise_smul_def]
  change Ideal.map
    ((galRestrict ℤ (FractionRing ℤ) (FractionRing OK) OK (conjAutFractionRingGal K) :
        OK ≃ₐ[ℤ] OK) : OK →+* OK) I =
      Ideal.map (conjAutRingOfIntegers K : OK →+* OK) I
  rw [galRestrict_conjAutFractionRingGal]
  rfl

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.ringOfIntegersBasisOfModFourNeOne_repr_zero
statement:
theorem ringOfIntegersBasisOfModFourNeOne_repr_zero (hd4 : d % 4 ≠ 1) (x : 𝓞K) :
    ((ringOfIntegersBasisOfModFourNeOne hd4).repr x 0 : ℚ) = (x : K).re
proof:
:= by
  let e := RingOfIntegers.ringOfIntegers_equiv_zsqrtd_of_mod_four_ne_one d hd4
  have h := RingOfIntegers.ringOfIntegers_equiv_zsqrtd_of_mod_four_ne_one_apply d hd4 x
  have hre : ((e x).re : ℚ) = (x : K).re := by
    simpa [Zsqrtd.toQsqrtdHom, Zsqrtd.toQsqrtd] using congrArg QuadraticAlgebra.re h
  change (((QuadraticAlgebra.basis d 0).repr (e x) 0 : ℤ) : ℚ) = (x : K).re
  simpa [QuadraticAlgebra.basis] using hre

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.ringOfIntegersBasisOfModFourNeOne_repr_one
statement:
theorem ringOfIntegersBasisOfModFourNeOne_repr_one (hd4 : d % 4 ≠ 1) (x : 𝓞K) :

proof:
:= by
  let e := RingOfIntegers.ringOfIntegers_equiv_zsqrtd_of_mod_four_ne_one d hd4
  have h := RingOfIntegers.ringOfIntegers_equiv_zsqrtd_of_mod_four_ne_one_apply d hd4 x
  have him : ((e x).im : ℚ) = (x : K).im := by
    simpa [Zsqrtd.toQsqrtdHom, Zsqrtd.toQsqrtd] using congrArg QuadraticAlgebra.im h
  change (((QuadraticAlgebra.basis d 0).repr (e x) 1 : ℤ) : ℚ) = (x : K).im
  simpa [QuadraticAlgebra.basis] using him

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.ringOfIntegersBasisOfEq_repr_zero
statement:
theorem ringOfIntegersBasisOfEq_repr_zero (k : ℤ) (hk : d = 1 + 4 * k) (x : 𝓞K) :
    ((ringOfIntegersBasisOfEq k hk).repr x 0 : ℚ) = (x : K).re - (x : K).im
proof:
:= by
  subst hk
  let e := RingOfIntegers.ringOfIntegers_equiv_zOnePlusSqrtOverTwo_of_eq
    (1 + 4 * k) k rfl
  have h := RingOfIntegers.ringOfIntegers_equiv_zOnePlusSqrtOverTwo_of_eq_apply k x
  have hre :
      ((e x).re : ℚ) + ((e x).im : ℚ) / 2 =
        (x : Qsqrtd (((1 + 4 * k : ℤ) : ℚ))).re := by
    simpa [e, ZOnePlusSqrtdOverTwo.toQsqrtdHom, ZOnePlusSqrtdOverTwo.toQsqrtdFun]
      using congrArg QuadraticAlgebra.re h
  have him :
      ((e x).im : ℚ) / 2 = (x : Qsqrtd (((1 + 4 * k : ℤ) : ℚ))).im := by
    simpa [e, ZOnePlusSqrtdOverTwo.toQsqrtdHom, ZOnePlusSqrtdOverTwo.toQsqrtdFun]
      using congrArg QuadraticAlgebra.im h
  have hcoord : ((e x).re : ℚ) =
      (x : Qsqrtd (((1 + 4 * k : ℤ) : ℚ))).re -
        (x : Qsqrtd (((1 + 4 * k : ℤ) : ℚ))).im := by
    nlinarith
  change (((QuadraticAlgebra.basis k 1).repr (e x) 0 : ℤ) : ℚ) =
    (x : Qsqrtd (((1 + 4 * k : ℤ) : ℚ))).re -
      (x : Qsqrtd (((1 + 4 * k : ℤ) : ℚ))).im
  simpa [QuadraticAlgebra.basis] using hcoord

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.ringOfIntegersBasisOfEq_repr_one
statement:
theorem ringOfIntegersBasisOfEq_repr_one (k : ℤ) (hk : d = 1 + 4 * k) (x : 𝓞K) :
    ((ringOfIntegersBasisOfEq k hk).repr x 1 : ℚ) = 2 * (x : K).im
proof:
:= by
  subst hk
  let e := RingOfIntegers.ringOfIntegers_equiv_zOnePlusSqrtOverTwo_of_eq
    (1 + 4 * k) k rfl
  have h := RingOfIntegers.ringOfIntegers_equiv_zOnePlusSqrtOverTwo_of_eq_apply k x
  have him :
      ((e x).im : ℚ) / 2 = (x : Qsqrtd (((1 + 4 * k : ℤ) : ℚ))).im := by
    simpa [e, ZOnePlusSqrtdOverTwo.toQsqrtdHom, ZOnePlusSqrtdOverTwo.toQsqrtdFun]
      using congrArg QuadraticAlgebra.im h
  have hcoord : ((e x).im : ℚ) =
      2 * (x : Qsqrtd (((1 + 4 * k : ℤ) : ℚ))).im := by
    nlinarith
  change (((QuadraticAlgebra.basis k 1).repr (e x) 1 : ℤ) : ℚ) =
    2 * (x : Qsqrtd (((1 + 4 * k : ℤ) : ℚ))).im
  simpa [QuadraticAlgebra.basis] using hcoord

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.ringOfIntegersBasisOfModFourEqOne_repr_zero
statement:
theorem ringOfIntegersBasisOfModFourEqOne_repr_zero (hd4 : d % 4 = 1) (x : 𝓞K) :
    ((ringOfIntegersBasisOfModFourEqOne hd4).repr x 0 : ℚ) = (x : K).re - (x : K).im
proof:
:= by
  let e := RingOfIntegers.ringOfIntegers_equiv_zOnePlusSqrtOverTwo_of_mod_four_eq_one d hd4
  have hre := ringOfIntegers_equiv_zOnePlusSqrtOverTwo_of_mod_four_eq_one_re d hd4 x
  have him := ringOfIntegers_equiv_zOnePlusSqrtOverTwo_of_mod_four_eq_one_im d hd4 x
  have hcoord : ((e x).re : ℚ) = (x : K).re - (x : K).im := by
    dsimp [e] at hre him
    nlinarith
  change ((e x).re : ℚ) = (x : K).re - (x : K).im
  exact hcoord

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.ringOfIntegersBasisOfModFourEqOne_repr_one
statement:
theorem ringOfIntegersBasisOfModFourEqOne_repr_one (hd4 : d % 4 = 1) (x : 𝓞K) :
    ((ringOfIntegersBasisOfModFourEqOne hd4).repr x 1 : ℚ) = 2 * (x : K).im

  have hcoord : ((e x).im : ℚ) = 2 * (x : K).im := by
    dsimp [e] at him
    nlinarith
  change ((e x).im : ℚ) = 2 * (x : K).im
  exact hcoord

statement:
theorem isTotallyComplex_iff_ofAlgEquiv (e : K ≃ₐ[ℚ] L) :
    IsTotallyComplex K ↔ IsTotallyComplex L
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by
    letI := h

name: exists_top_generator_sq_rat
statement:
private theorem exists_top_generator_sq_rat
    (K : Type*) [Field K] [Algebra ℚ K] [Algebra.IsQuadraticExtension ℚ K] :
    ∃ (β : K) (q : ℚ),
      IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ ({β} : Set K) = ⊤ ∧ β * β = algebraMap ℚ K q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨α, hαtop⟩ := Field.exists_primitive_element ℚ K
  let b : ℚ := (minpoly ℚ α).coeff 1
  let c : ℚ := (minpoly ℚ α).coeff 0
  have hdeg : (minpoly ℚ α).natDegree = 2 := by
    have h := (Field.primitive_element_iff_minpoly_natDegree_eq ℚ α).mp hαtop
    have hfin : Module.finrank ℚ K = 2 := Algebra.IsQuadraticExtension.finrank_eq_two ℚ K
    simpa [hfin] using h
  have hmonic : (minpoly ℚ α).Monic :=
    minpoly.monic (IsIntegral.of_finite (R := ℚ) (B := K) α)
  have hpoly : minpoly ℚ α = X ^ 2 + C b * X + C c := by
    rcases (Polynomial.isMonicOfDegree_two_iff.mp ⟨hdeg, hmonic⟩) with ⟨b', c', hp⟩
    have hb : b' = b := by simp [b, hp]
    have hc : c' = c := by simp [c, hp]
    simpa [b, c, hb, hc] using hp
  have hroot : α * α + algebraMap ℚ K b * α + algebraMap ℚ K c = 0 := by
    have h : aeval α (X ^ 2 + C b * X + C c : ℚ[X]) = 0 := by
      simpa [hpoly] using minpoly.aeval ℚ α
    simpa [aeval_def, sq] using h
  refine ⟨α + algebraMap ℚ K (b / 2), b ^ 2 / 4 - c, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply top_unique
    rw [← hαtop]
    refine (IntermediateField.adjoin_simple_le_iff).2 ?_
    set β : K := α + algebraMap ℚ K (b / 2) with hβdef
    have hβ : β ∈ IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ ({β} : Set K) :=
      IntermediateField.mem_adjoin_simple_self ℚ β
    have hconst : algebraMap ℚ K (b / 2) ∈ IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ ({β} : Set K) :=
      IntermediateField.adjoin.algebraMap_mem ℚ ({β} : Set K) (b / 2)
    simpa [hβdef, sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_comm] using sub_mem hβ hconst
  · have hroot' : α * α + algebraMap ℚ K b * α = - algebraMap ℚ K c := by
      linear_combination hroot
    have hcoeff : algebraMap ℚ K (b / 2) + algebraMap ℚ K (b / 2) = algebraMap ℚ K b := by
      exact_mod_cast (by ring : b / 2 + b / 2 = b)
    have hsq : (algebraMap ℚ K (b / 2)) ^ 2 = algebraMap ℚ K (b ^ 2 / 4) := by
      have h : (b / 2) ^ 2 = b ^ 2 / 4 := by ring
      simpa [pow_two, map_mul] using congrArg (algebraMap ℚ K) h
    calc
      (α + algebraMap ℚ K (b / 2)) * (α + algebraMap ℚ K (b / 2))
          = α * α + (algebraMap ℚ K (b / 2) + algebraMap ℚ K (b / 2)) * α +
              (algebraMap ℚ K (b / 2)) ^ 2 := by
                ring
      _ = α * α + algebraMap ℚ K b * α + algebraMap ℚ K (b ^ 2 / 4) := by
        rw [hcoeff, hsq]
      _ = - algebraMap ℚ K c + algebraMap ℚ K (b ^ 2 / 4) := by
        rw [hroot']
      _ = algebraMap ℚ K (b ^ 2 / 4 - c) := by
        exact_mod_cast (by ring : -c + b ^ 2 / 4 = b ^ 2 / 4 - c)

name: top_generator_ne_algebraMap
statement:
private lemma top_generator_ne_algebraMap
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [Algebra ℚ K] [Algebra.IsQuadraticExtension ℚ K]
    {β : K} (hβtop : IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ ({β} : Set K) = ⊤) (s : ℚ) :
    β ≠ algebraMap ℚ K s
proof:
:= by
  intro hβalg
  have htop' : (⊥ : IntermediateField ℚ K) = ⊤ := by
    have hA : IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ ({algebraMap ℚ K s} : Set K) = ⊤ := by
      simpa [hβalg] using hβtop
    have hB : IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ ({algebraMap ℚ K s} : Set K) = ⊥ := by simp
    exact hB.symm.trans hA
  have h1 : Module.finrank ℚ (⊥ : IntermediateField ℚ K) = 1 := by simp
  have h2 : Module.finrank ℚ (⊤ : IntermediateField ℚ K) = 2 := by
    simpa using Algebra.IsQuadraticExtension.finrank_eq_two ℚ K
  rw [htop'] at h1
  omega

name: not_isSquare_of_top_generator_sq
statement:
private lemma not_isSquare_of_top_generator_sq
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [Algebra ℚ K] [Algebra.IsQuadraticExtension ℚ K]
    {β : K} {q : ℚ} (hβtop : IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ ({β} : Set K) = ⊤)
    (hβsq : β * β = algebraMap ℚ K q) :
    ¬ IsSquare q
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨r, hr⟩
  have hfac : (β - algebraMap ℚ K r) * (β + algebraMap ℚ K r) = 0 := by
    have hmapsq : (algebraMap ℚ K r) ^ 2 = algebraMap ℚ K (r ^ 2) := by
      simp [pow_two, map_mul]
    calc
      (β - algebraMap ℚ K r) * (β + algebraMap ℚ K r) =
          β ^ 2 - (algebraMap ℚ K r) ^ 2 := by
        ring
      _ = β * β - algebraMap ℚ K (r ^ 2) := by rw [pow_two, hmapsq]
      _ = 0 := by simp [hr, hβsq, pow_two]
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hfac with h | h
  · exact top_generator_ne_algebraMap hβtop r (sub_eq_zero.mp h)
  · exact top_generator_ne_algebraMap hβtop (-r)
      (by rw [map_neg]; exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h)

name: algEquiv_qsqrtd_of_sq_eq
statement:
private theorem algEquiv_qsqrtd_of_sq_eq
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [Algebra ℚ K] [Algebra.IsQuadraticExtension ℚ K]
    {q : ℚ} [Fact (¬ IsSquare q)] {β : K} (hβsq : β * β = algebraMap ℚ K q) :
    Nonempty (K ≃ₐ[ℚ] Qsqrtd q)
proof:
:= by
  let f : Qsqrtd q →ₐ[ℚ] K :=
    (QuadraticAlgebra.lift (R := ℚ) (a := q) (b := (0 : ℚ)) (A := K))
      ⟨β, by simpa [← Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] using hβsq⟩
  have hdim : Module.finrank ℚ (Qsqrtd q) = Module.finrank ℚ K := by
    have h1 : Module.finrank ℚ (Qsqrtd q) = 2 := by
      simpa using QuadraticAlgebra.finrank_eq_two q (0 : ℚ)
    have h2 : Module.finrank ℚ K = 2 := by
      simpa using Algebra.IsQuadraticExtension.finrank_eq_two ℚ K
    omega
  have hinj : Function.Injective f.toLinearMap := RingHom.injective f.toRingHom
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective f.toLinearMap :=
    (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective_of_finrank_eq_finrank hdim).mp hinj
  have hbij : Function.Bijective f := ⟨RingHom.injective f.toRingHom, hsurj⟩
  exact ⟨(AlgEquiv.ofBijective f hbij).symm⟩

name: exists_rat_param_of_isQuadraticField
statement:
private theorem exists_rat_param_of_isQuadraticField
    (K : Type*) [Field K] [Algebra ℚ K] [Algebra.IsQuadraticExtension ℚ K] :
    ∃ q : ℚ, ¬ IsSquare q ∧ Nonempty (K ≃ₐ[ℚ] Qsqrtd q)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨β, q, hβtop, hβsq⟩ := exists_top_generator_sq_rat K
  have hq : ¬ IsSquare q := not_isSquare_of_top_generator_sq hβtop hβsq
  letI : Fact (¬ IsSquare q) := ⟨hq⟩
  exact ⟨q, hq, algEquiv_qsqrtd_of_sq_eq hβsq⟩

name: exists_squarefree_int_param_of_isQuadraticField
statement:
theorem exists_squarefree_int_param_of_isQuadraticField
    (K : Type*) [Field K] [Algebra ℚ K] [Algebra.IsQuadraticExtension ℚ K] :
    ∃ z : ℤ, Squarefree z ∧ z ≠ 1 ∧ Nonempty (K ≃ₐ[ℚ] Qsqrtd (z : ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, _hq, hKq⟩ := exists_rat_param_of_isQuadraticField K
  rcases hKq with ⟨eKq⟩
  obtain ⟨n, hqn⟩ := Qsqrtd_iso_int_param q
  rcases hqn with ⟨eqn⟩
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by
    intro hn0
    subst n
    have e : K ≃ₐ[ℚ] Qsqrtd (0 : ℚ) := eKq.trans eqn
    have hF : IsField (Qsqrtd (0 : ℚ)) := e.toMulEquiv.symm.isField (Field.toIsField K)
    exact Qsqrtd.zero_not_isField hF
  obtain ⟨z, hzsf, hNz⟩ := Qsqrtd_iso_squarefree_int_param (d := n) hn0
  rcases hNz with ⟨enz⟩
  have hz1 : z ≠ 1 := by
    intro hz1
    subst z
    have e : K ≃ₐ[ℚ] Qsqrtd (1 : ℚ) := (eKq.trans eqn).trans enz
    have hF : IsField (Qsqrtd (1 : ℚ)) := e.toMulEquiv.symm.isField (Field.toIsField K)
    exact Qsqrtd.one_not_isField hF
  exact ⟨z, hzsf, hz1, ⟨(eKq.trans eqn).trans enz⟩⟩

name: exists_algEquiv_qsqrtd
statement:
theorem exists_algEquiv_qsqrtd
    (K : Type*) [Field K] [Algebra ℚ K] [QuadraticField K] :

name: isQuadraticField_iff_exists_squarefree_int_param
statement:
theorem isQuadraticField_iff_exists_squarefree_int_param
    (K : Type*) [Field K] [Algebra ℚ K] :
    Algebra.IsQuadraticExtension ℚ K ↔
      ∃ z : ℤ, Squarefree z ∧ z ≠ 1 ∧ Nonempty (K ≃ₐ[ℚ] Qsqrtd (z : ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hK
    letI : Algebra.IsQuadraticExtension ℚ K := hK
    exact exists_squarefree_int_param_of_isQuadraticField K
  · rintro ⟨z, hzsf, hz1, ⟨e⟩⟩
    letI : Fact (Squarefree z) := ⟨hzsf⟩
    letI : Fact (z ≠ 1) := ⟨hz1⟩
    have h2 : Module.finrank ℚ (Qsqrtd (z : ℚ)) = 2 := by
      simpa using QuadraticAlgebra.finrank_eq_two (z : ℚ) (0 : ℚ)
    refine { finrank_eq_two' := ?_ }
    exact (LinearEquiv.finrank_eq e.toLinearEquiv).trans h2

name: QuadraticField.univ_aut_eq_pair
statement:
theorem univ_aut_eq_pair [DecidableEq (K ≃ₐ[ℚ] K)] :
    (Finset.univ : Finset (K ≃ₐ[ℚ] K)) = {AlgEquiv.refl, conjAut K}
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Algebra.IsSeparable ℚ K := Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isSeparable_of_perfectField
  haveI : IsGalois ℚ K := Algebra.IsQuadraticExtension.isGalois ℚ K
  have hne : (AlgEquiv.refl : K ≃ₐ[ℚ] K) ≠ conjAut K := (Conj.conj_ne_refl).symm
  have hcard : Fintype.card (K ≃ₐ[ℚ] K) = 2 := by
    rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank,
      Algebra.IsQuadraticExtension.finrank_eq_two]
  refine (Finset.eq_univ_of_card _ ?_).symm
  rw [Finset.card_pair hne, hcard]

name: QuadraticField.add_conj_eq_trace_image
statement:

    x + conjAut K x = algebraMap ℚ K (Algebra.trace ℚ K x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : Algebra.IsSeparable ℚ K := Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isSeparable_of_perfectField
  haveI : IsGalois ℚ K := Algebra.IsQuadraticExtension.isGalois ℚ K
  have hne : (AlgEquiv.refl : K ≃ₐ[ℚ] K) ≠ conjAut K := (Conj.conj_ne_refl).symm
  rw [trace_eq_sum_automorphisms, univ_aut_eq_pair, Finset.sum_pair hne]
  rfl

proof:
:= by

  haveI : IsGalois ℚ K := Algebra.IsQuadraticExtension.isGalois ℚ K
  have hne : (AlgEquiv.refl : K ≃ₐ[ℚ] K) ≠ conjAut K := (Conj.conj_ne_refl).symm
  rw [Algebra.norm_eq_prod_automorphisms, univ_aut_eq_pair, Finset.prod_pair hne]
  rfl

name: Qsqrtd_iso_int_param
statement:
theorem Qsqrtd_iso_int_param (d : ℚ) :
    ∃ z : ℤ, Nonempty (Qsqrtd d ≃ₐ[ℚ] Qsqrtd (z : ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, n, hn0, hd⟩ : ∃ m n : ℤ, n ≠ 0 ∧ d = m / n := by
    have hd := ne_of_gt (Rat.den_pos d)
    exact ⟨d.num, d.den, Int.ofNat_ne_zero.mpr hd, (Rat.num_div_den d).symm⟩
  use m * n
  have ha : (n : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hn0
  
  
  have hrescale : Qsqrtd d ≃ₐ[ℚ] Qsqrtd (n ^ 2 * d) := Qsqrtd.rescaleOfNeZero d n ha
  have heq : (n : ℚ) ^ 2 * d = m * n := by
    rw [hd]
    field_simp [mul_assoc]
  have hcast : (m * n : ℚ) = (m * n : ℤ) := (Int.cast_mul m n).symm
  exact ⟨hrescale.trans (AlgEquiv.cast (by rw [heq, hcast]))⟩

name: Qsqrtd_iso_squarefree_int_param
statement:
theorem Qsqrtd_iso_squarefree_int_param {d : ℤ} (hd : d ≠ 0) :
    ∃ z : ℤ, Squarefree z ∧ Nonempty (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ) ≃ₐ[ℚ] Qsqrtd (z : ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, a, heq, ha⟩ := exists_sq_mul_squarefree d.natAbs
  have hb : b ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    subst h
    simp at heq
    exact hd (Int.natAbs_eq_zero.mp heq.symm)
  refine ⟨d.sign * ↑a, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← Int.squarefree_natAbs]
    rwa [Int.natAbs_mul, Int.natAbs_sign_of_ne_zero hd, Int.natAbs_natCast, one_mul]
  · have hbQ : (b : ℚ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hb
    
    
    have hrescale := Qsqrtd.rescaleOfNeZero (↑d) (↑b)⁻¹ (inv_ne_zero hbQ)
    have hd_int : d = d.sign * (↑b ^ 2 * ↑a) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [(Int.sign_mul_natAbs d).symm]
      congr 1
      exact_mod_cast heq.symm
    have hkey : ((↑b : ℚ)⁻¹) ^ 2 * (↑d : ℚ) = ↑(d.sign * (↑a : ℤ)) := by
      have hd_rat : (d : ℚ) = (d.sign : ℚ) * ((b : ℚ) ^ 2 * (a : ℚ)) := by
        exact_mod_cast hd_int
      rw [hd_rat]
      field_simp
      push_cast
      rfl
    exact ⟨hrescale.trans
      (AlgEquiv.cast (A := fun d => QuadraticAlgebra ℚ d 0) hkey)⟩

name: squarefree_eq_of_rat_sq_mul
proof:
:= by
  have hd₁0 : d₁ ≠ 0 := Squarefree.ne_zero hd₁
  have hd₂0 : d₂ ≠ 0 := Squarefree.ne_zero hd₂
  have hd₁Q : (d₁ : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hd₁0
  have hd₂Q : (d₂ : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hd₂0
  have hratio : IsSquare ((d₁ : ℚ) / (d₂ : ℚ)) := by
    refine ⟨r, ?_⟩
    calc
      (d₁ : ℚ) / (d₂ : ℚ) = ((d₂ : ℚ) * r ^ 2) / (d₂ : ℚ) := by simp [hr]
      _ = r ^ 2 := by field_simp [hd₂Q]
      _ = r * r := by ring
  have hratio' : IsSquare ((d₂ : ℚ) / (d₁ : ℚ)) := by
    rcases hratio with ⟨s, hs⟩
    refine ⟨s⁻¹, ?_⟩
    calc
      (d₂ : ℚ) / (d₁ : ℚ) = ((d₁ : ℚ) / (d₂ : ℚ))⁻¹ := by field_simp [hd₁Q, hd₂Q]
      _ = (s * s)⁻¹ := by simp [hs]
      _ = s⁻¹ * s⁻¹ := by
        have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := by
          intro hs0
          have : ((d₁ : ℚ) / (d₂ : ℚ)) = 0 := by simpa [hs0] using hs
          have hd10 : (d₁ : ℚ) = 0 := by
            field_simp [hd₂Q] at this
            simpa [mul_zero] using this
          exact hd₁Q hd10
        field_simp [hs0]
  have hd21 : d₂ ∣ d₁ := int_dvd_of_ratio_square d₁ d₂ hd₂0 hd₂ hratio
  have hd12 : d₁ ∣ d₂ := int_dvd_of_ratio_square d₂ d₁ hd₁0 hd₁ hratio'
  
  
  have hassoc : Associated d₁ d₂ := associated_of_dvd_dvd hd12 hd21
  rcases (Int.associated_iff.mp hassoc) with hEq | hNeg
  · exact hEq
  · have : ((d₁ : ℚ) / d₂) = -1 := by
      rw [hNeg]
      push_cast
      field_simp [hd₂Q]
    
    
    exfalso
    exact not_isSquare_neg_one_rat (by rwa [this] at hratio)

name: Qsqrtd.param_unique
statement:
theorem Qsqrtd.param_unique (φ : Qsqrtd (d₁ : ℚ) ≃ₐ[ℚ] Qsqrtd (d₂ : ℚ))
    (hsf₁ : Squarefree d₁) (h1₁ : d₁ ≠ 1) (hsf₂ : Squarefree d₂) : d₁ = d₂
proof:
:=
  
  
  squarefree_eq_of_rat_sq_mul hsf₁ hsf₂
    (Qsqrtd.algEquiv_param_rel (not_isSquare_ratCast_of_squarefree_ne_one hsf₁ h1₁) φ).2.2

statement:
theorem SqfreeParam.eq_of_algEquiv {p q : SqfreeParam}
    (e : @AlgEquiv ℚ (Qsqrtd (p.d : ℚ)) (Qsqrtd (q.d : ℚ)) Rat.commSemiring
      QuadraticAlgebra.instCommSemiring.toSemiring QuadraticAlgebra.instCommSemiring.toSemiring
      QuadraticAlgebra.instAlgebra QuadraticAlgebra.instAlgebra) : p = q
proof:
:=
  SqfreeParam.eq_of_d_eq
    (Qsqrtd.param_unique p.d q.d e p.squarefree p.ne_one q.squarefree)

name: Qsqrtd.algEquiv_self_eq_refl_or_star
statement:
theorem algEquiv_self_eq_refl_or_star
    (σ : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ) ≃ₐ[ℚ] Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) :
    σ = AlgEquiv.refl ∨ σ = Qsqrtd.starAlgEquiv (d : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  
  
  
  
  have hφ_d : σ.toRingEquiv (⟨(d : ℚ), 0⟩ : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) = ⟨(d : ℚ), 0⟩ := by
    have hleft : (⟨(d : ℚ), 0⟩ : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) =
        algebraMap ℚ (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) (d : ℚ) := by ext <;> simp
    rw [show (σ.toRingEquiv ⟨(d : ℚ), 0⟩ : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) = σ ⟨(d : ℚ), 0⟩ from rfl, hleft]
    exact σ.commutes (d : ℚ)
  obtain ⟨ha, -, hr⟩ :=
    ringEquiv_param_rel (not_isSquare_ratCast_of_squarefree_ne_one Fact.out Fact.out)
      σ.toRingEquiv hφ_d
  simp only [AlgEquiv.coe_toRingEquiv] at ha hr
  set a := (σ (⟨0, 1⟩ : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ))).re
  set b := (σ (⟨0, 1⟩ : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ))).im
  have hφ_eta : σ (⟨0, 1⟩ : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) = ⟨a, b⟩ := by ext <;> rfl
  have hdQ : (d : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Squarefree.ne_zero (Fact.out : Squarefree d))
  have hbsq : b ^ 2 = 1 := mul_left_cancel₀ hdQ (by rw [mul_one]; exact hr.symm)
  
  have hAM :
      ∀ q : ℚ, algebraMap ℚ (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) q = (⟨q, 0⟩ : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) := by
    intro q
    ext <;> simp
  
  have hdecomp : ∀ x : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ),
      x = algebraMap ℚ (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) x.re +
        algebraMap ℚ (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) x.im * ⟨0, 1⟩ := by
    intro x
    rw [hAM x.re, hAM x.im]
    ext <;> simp [QuadraticAlgebra.mk_mul_mk]
  
  rcases sq_eq_one_iff.mp hbsq with hb1 | hbneg1
  · 
    refine Or.inl (AlgEquiv.ext fun x => ?_)
    have hσε : σ (⟨0, 1⟩ : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) = ⟨0, 1⟩ := by rw [hφ_eta, ha, hb1]
    conv_lhs => rw [hdecomp x]
    rw [map_add, map_mul, σ.commutes, σ.commutes, hσε, ← hdecomp x]
    rfl
  · 
    
    refine Or.inr (AlgEquiv.ext fun x => ?_)
    have hσε : σ (⟨0, 1⟩ : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) = ⟨0, -1⟩ := by rw [hφ_eta, ha, hbneg1]
    rw [Qsqrtd.starAlgEquiv_apply]
    conv_lhs => rw [hdecomp x]
    rw [map_add, map_mul, σ.commutes, σ.commutes, hσε, hAM x.re, hAM x.im]
    ext <;> simp [QuadraticAlgebra.mk_mul_mk]

 lemma zero_not_isReduced : ¬ IsReduced (Qsqrtd (0 : ℚ)) := by

 lemma one_not_isField : ¬ IsField (Qsqrtd (1 : ℚ)) := by
  intro hF
  haveI := hF.isDomain
  
  
  have hprod : (⟨1, 1⟩ : Qsqrtd 1) * ⟨1, -1⟩ = 0 := by

  have hne : (⟨1, 1⟩ : Qsqrtd 1) ≠ 0 := by

  have hne' : (⟨1, -1⟩ : Qsqrtd 1) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact one_ne_zero (congr_arg QuadraticAlgebra.re h)
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hprod with h | h <;> contradiction

name: Qsqrtd.ringEquiv_param_rel
statement:
theorem ringEquiv_param_rel {d d' : ℚ} (hd : ¬ IsSquare d)
    (φ : Qsqrtd d ≃+* Qsqrtd d') (hfix : φ ⟨d, 0⟩ = ⟨d, 0⟩) :
    (φ ⟨0, 1⟩).re = 0 ∧ (φ ⟨0, 1⟩).im ≠ 0 ∧ d = d' * (φ ⟨0, 1⟩).im ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  set a := (φ ⟨0, 1⟩).re
  set b := (φ ⟨0, 1⟩).im
  
  have hε_sq : (⟨0, 1⟩ : Qsqrtd d) * ⟨0, 1⟩ = ⟨d, 0⟩ := by
    ext <;> simp [QuadraticAlgebra.mk_mul_mk]
  have hφ_sq : φ ⟨0, 1⟩ * φ ⟨0, 1⟩ = ⟨d, 0⟩ := by rw [← map_mul, hε_sq, hfix]
  have hφ_eta : φ ⟨0, 1⟩ = ⟨a, b⟩ := by ext <;> rfl
  
  have hre : a ^ 2 + d' * b ^ 2 = d := by
    have := congr_arg QuadraticAlgebra.re hφ_sq
    rw [hφ_eta, QuadraticAlgebra.mk_mul_mk] at this
    simp at this
    nlinarith
  have him : 2 * a * b = 0 := by
    have := congr_arg QuadraticAlgebra.im hφ_sq
    rw [hφ_eta, QuadraticAlgebra.mk_mul_mk] at this
    simp at this
    linarith
  
  have hb : b ≠ 0 := by
    intro hb0
    simp [hb0] at hre
    exact hd ⟨a, by nlinarith⟩
  have ha : a = 0 := by
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp him with h | h
    · exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_left (by norm_num)
    · exact absurd h hb
  exact ⟨ha, hb, by nlinarith [hre, ha]⟩

name: Qsqrtd.algEquiv_param_rel
statement:
theorem algEquiv_param_rel {d d' : ℚ} (hd : ¬ IsSquare d)
    (φ : Qsqrtd d ≃ₐ[ℚ] Qsqrtd d') :
    (φ ⟨0, 1⟩).re = 0 ∧ (φ ⟨0, 1⟩).im ≠ 0 ∧ d = d' * (φ ⟨0, 1⟩).im ^ 2
proof:
:=
  ringEquiv_param_rel hd φ.toRingEquiv <| by
    have hleft : (⟨d, 0⟩ : Qsqrtd d) = algebraMap ℚ (Qsqrtd d) d :=
      (QuadraticAlgebra.algebraMap_eq (R := ℚ) (a := d) (b := 0) d).symm
    have hright : (⟨d, 0⟩ : Qsqrtd d') = algebraMap ℚ (Qsqrtd d') d :=
      (QuadraticAlgebra.algebraMap_eq (R := ℚ) (a := d') (b := 0) d).symm
    simp [hleft, hright]

name: imPartRatio_eq_im
statement: theorem imPartRatio_eq_im (x : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) : imPartRatio x = x.im
proof:
:= by

name: eq_imPartRatio_smul_sqrt_of_star_neg
statement:
theorem eq_imPartRatio_smul_sqrt_of_star_neg {x : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)} (hx : star x = -x) :
    x = (imPartRatio x : ℚ) • (⟨0, 1⟩ : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  have hre : x.re = 0 := by
    have hre_star : (star x).re = x.re := by simp [QuadraticAlgebra.re_star]
    have hre_neg : (-x).re = -x.re := by simp
    rw [hx] at hre_star
    rw [hre_neg] at hre_star
    linarith
  have him : (imPartRatio x : ℚ) = x.im := by simp [imPartRatio, QuadraticAlgebra.basis]
  simpa [hre, him] using (QuadraticAlgebra.mk_eta x).symm

name: eq_re_smul_one_of_star_self
statement:
theorem eq_re_smul_one_of_star_self {x : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)} (hx : star x = x) :
    x = (x.re : ℚ) • (1 : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  have him : x.im = 0 := by
    have him_star : (star x).im = -x.im := by simp [QuadraticAlgebra.im_star]
    rw [hx] at him_star
    linarith
  apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext
  · simp [QuadraticAlgebra.re_one]
  · simp [him, QuadraticAlgebra.im_one]

name: eq_algebraMap_re_of_star_self
statement:
theorem eq_algebraMap_re_of_star_self {x : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)} (hx : star x = x) :
    x = algebraMap ℚ (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) x.re
proof:
:=
  (eq_re_smul_one_of_star_self hx).trans (Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one x.re).symm

name: imPartRatio_wedge
statement:
theorem imPartRatio_wedge (u v : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) :
    imPartRatio (u * star v - v * star u) =
      2 * ((u.im : ℚ) * v.re - u.re * v.im)
proof:
:= by
  rw [imPartRatio_eq_im]
  simp only [QuadraticAlgebra.im_sub, QuadraticAlgebra.im_mul, QuadraticAlgebra.re_star,
    QuadraticAlgebra.im_star]
  ring

name: imPartRatio_wedge_mul_left
statement:
theorem imPartRatio_wedge_mul_left (x u v : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) :
    imPartRatio (x * u * star (x * v) - x * v * star (x * u)) =
      ((x.re : ℚ) ^ 2 - (d : ℚ) * x.im ^ 2) * imPartRatio (u * star v - v * star u)
proof:
:= by
  rw [imPartRatio_wedge, imPartRatio_wedge]
  simp only [QuadraticAlgebra.re_mul, QuadraticAlgebra.im_mul]
  ring

name: Qsqrtd.nonempty_algEquiv_of_isSquareRatio
statement:
theorem nonempty_algEquiv_of_isSquareRatio {d d' : ℚ} :
    IsSquareRatio d d' → Nonempty (Qsqrtd d ≃ₐ[ℚ] Qsqrtd d')
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨Qsqrtd.rescale d a⟩

name: Qsqrtd.isSquareRatio_iff_isSquareRatioByDivision
statement:
theorem isSquareRatio_iff_isSquareRatioByDivision {d d' : ℚ} (hd : d ≠ 0) :
    IsSquareRatio d d' ↔ IsSquareRatioByDivision d d'
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
    field_simp [hd]
  · rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
    refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
    calc
      d' = d' / d * d := by field_simp [hd]
      _ = (a : ℚ) ^ 2 * d := by rw [ha]

name: Qsqrtd.algEquiv_iff_isSquareRatio
statement:
theorem algEquiv_iff_isSquareRatio
    (d d' : ℚ) [Fact (¬ IsSquare d)] [Fact (¬ IsSquare d')] :
    Nonempty (Qsqrtd d ≃ₐ[ℚ] Qsqrtd d') ↔ IsSquareRatio d d'
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨φ⟩
    obtain ⟨-, hb, hr⟩ := algEquiv_param_rel (Fact.out : ¬ IsSquare d) φ
    set b := (φ ⟨0, 1⟩).im
    
    refine ⟨Units.mk0 b⁻¹ (inv_ne_zero hb), ?_⟩
    change d' = (b⁻¹) ^ 2 * d
    rw [hr]
    field_simp [hb]
  · exact nonempty_algEquiv_of_isSquareRatio

name: Qsqrtd.algEquiv_iff_isSquareRatioByDivision
statement:
theorem algEquiv_iff_isSquareRatioByDivision
    (d d' : ℚ) [Fact (¬ IsSquare d)] [Fact (¬ IsSquare d')] :
    Nonempty (Qsqrtd d ≃ₐ[ℚ] Qsqrtd d') ↔ IsSquareRatioByDivision d d'
proof:
:= by
  have hd : d ≠ 0 := by
    intro hd
    exact (Fact.out : ¬ IsSquare d) (by rw [hd]; exact ⟨0, by ring⟩)
  exact (algEquiv_iff_isSquareRatio d d').trans (isSquareRatio_iff_isSquareRatioByDivision hd)

name: Qsqrtd.realEmbedding_apply
statement:
theorem realEmbedding_apply (d : ℤ) (r : ℝ) (hr : r * r = (d : ℝ))
    (z : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) :
    realEmbedding d r hr z = (z.re : ℝ) + (z.im : ℝ) * r
proof:
:= by
  change (QuadraticAlgebra.lift (R := ℚ) (a := (d : ℚ)) (b := (0 : ℚ))
      ⟨r, hr.trans (by simp [Algebra.smul_def])⟩ : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ) →ₐ[ℚ] ℝ) z =
    (z.re : ℝ) + (z.im : ℝ) * r
  simp [QuadraticAlgebra.lift, Algebra.smul_def]

name: Qsqrtd.realEmbeddingPos_apply
statement:
theorem realEmbeddingPos_apply (d : ℤ) (hd : 0 ≤ (d : ℝ))
    (z : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) :
    realEmbeddingPos d hd z = (z.re : ℝ) + (z.im : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (d : ℝ)
proof:
:=
  realEmbedding_apply d (Real.sqrt (d : ℝ)) (by simpa [sq] using Real.sq_sqrt hd) z

name: Qsqrtd.realEmbeddingNeg_apply
statement:
theorem realEmbeddingNeg_apply (d : ℤ) (hd : 0 ≤ (d : ℝ))
    (z : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) :
    realEmbeddingNeg d hd z = (z.re : ℝ) - (z.im : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (d : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [realEmbeddingNeg, realEmbedding_apply]
  ring

name: Qsqrtd.algHom_omega_eq_sqrt_or_neg
statement:
theorem algHom_omega_eq_sqrt_or_neg (d : ℤ) (φ : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ) →ₐ[ℚ] ℝ) :
    φ QuadraticAlgebra.omega = Real.sqrt (d : ℝ) ∨
      φ QuadraticAlgebra.omega = -Real.sqrt (d : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hsq :
      φ QuadraticAlgebra.omega * φ QuadraticAlgebra.omega = (d : ℝ) := by
    have h :=
      congrArg φ
        (QuadraticAlgebra.omega_mul_omega_eq_add (R := ℚ) (a := (d : ℚ)) (b := 0))
    simpa [Algebra.smul_def] using h
  have hsq' : φ QuadraticAlgebra.omega ^ 2 = (d : ℝ) := by
    simpa [sq] using hsq
  have habs : |φ QuadraticAlgebra.omega| = Real.sqrt (d : ℝ) := by
    rw [← Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs (φ QuadraticAlgebra.omega), hsq']
  rcases abs_cases (φ QuadraticAlgebra.omega) with h | h
  · left
    linarith
  · right
    linarith

name: Qsqrtd.algHom_eq_realEmbeddingPos_or_neg
statement:
theorem algHom_eq_realEmbeddingPos_or_neg
    (d : ℤ) (hd : 0 ≤ (d : ℝ)) (φ : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ) →ₐ[ℚ] ℝ) :
    φ = realEmbeddingPos d hd ∨ φ = realEmbeddingNeg d hd
proof:
:= by
  rcases algHom_omega_eq_sqrt_or_neg d φ with hω | hω
  · left
    apply QuadraticAlgebra.algHom_ext
    change φ QuadraticAlgebra.omega = realEmbeddingPos d hd QuadraticAlgebra.omega
    rw [hω, realEmbeddingPos_apply]
    simp
  · right
    apply QuadraticAlgebra.algHom_ext
    change φ QuadraticAlgebra.omega = realEmbeddingNeg d hd QuadraticAlgebra.omega
    rw [hω, realEmbeddingNeg_apply]
    simp

name: Qsqrtd.realEmbeddingPos_star
statement:
theorem realEmbeddingPos_star (d : ℤ) (hd : 0 ≤ (d : ℝ)) (z : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) :
    realEmbeddingPos d hd (star z) = realEmbeddingNeg d hd z
proof:
:= by
  rw [realEmbeddingPos_apply, realEmbeddingNeg_apply]
  simp [QuadraticAlgebra.re_star, QuadraticAlgebra.im_star]
  ring

name: Qsqrtd.realEmbeddingPos_conjAut
statement:
theorem realEmbeddingPos_conjAut
    (d : ℤ) [Fact (Squarefree d)] [Fact (d ≠ 1)] (hd : 0 ≤ (d : ℝ))
    (z : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) :
    realEmbeddingPos d hd (QuadraticField.conjAut (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) z) =
      realEmbeddingNeg d hd z
proof:
:= by
  change realEmbeddingPos d hd (star z) = realEmbeddingNeg d hd z
  exact realEmbeddingPos_star d hd z

name: Qsqrtd.forall_algHom_pos_iff_realEmbeddingPos_and_realEmbeddingNeg_pos
statement:
theorem forall_algHom_pos_iff_realEmbeddingPos_and_realEmbeddingNeg_pos
    (d : ℤ) (hd : 0 ≤ (d : ℝ)) (z : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) :
    (∀ σ : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ) →ₐ[ℚ] ℝ, 0 < σ z) ↔
      0 < realEmbeddingPos d hd z ∧ 0 < realEmbeddingNeg d hd z
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hz
    exact ⟨hz (realEmbeddingPos d hd), hz (realEmbeddingNeg d hd)⟩
  · intro hz σ
    rcases algHom_eq_realEmbeddingPos_or_neg d hd σ with hσ | hσ
    · rw [hσ]
      exact hz.1
    · rw [hσ]
      exact hz.2

name: Qsqrtd.re_pos_of_forall_algHom_pos_of_star_self
statement:
theorem re_pos_of_forall_algHom_pos_of_star_self
    (d : ℤ) (hd : 0 ≤ (d : ℝ)) {z : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)}
    (hzpos : ∀ σ : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ) →ₐ[ℚ] ℝ, 0 < σ z)
    (hfix : star z = z) :
    0 < z.re
proof:
:= by
  have hsign := (forall_algHom_pos_iff_realEmbeddingPos_and_realEmbeddingNeg_pos d hd z).mp hzpos
  have hpos : 0 < realEmbeddingPos d hd z := hsign.1
  rw [_root_.eq_algebraMap_re_of_star_self hfix] at hpos
  have hposR : (0 : ℝ) < z.re := by
    simpa using hpos
  exact_mod_cast hposR

name: Qsqrtd.norm_eq_realEmbeddingPos_mul_realEmbeddingNeg
statement:
theorem norm_eq_realEmbeddingPos_mul_realEmbeddingNeg (d : ℤ) (hd : 0 ≤ (d : ℝ))
    (z : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) :
    (Qsqrtd.norm z : ℝ) = realEmbeddingPos d hd z * realEmbeddingNeg d hd z
proof:
:= by
  rw [realEmbeddingPos_apply, realEmbeddingNeg_apply]
  simp [Qsqrtd.norm, QuadraticAlgebra.norm_def]
  ring_nf
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt hd]
  ring

name: Qsqrtd.norm_pos_of_realEmbedding_pos
statement:
theorem norm_pos_of_realEmbedding_pos (d : ℤ) (hd : 0 ≤ (d : ℝ))
    {z : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)}
    (hpos : 0 < realEmbeddingPos d hd z)
    (hneg : 0 < realEmbeddingNeg d hd z) :
    0 < (Qsqrtd.norm z : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_eq_realEmbeddingPos_mul_realEmbeddingNeg d hd z]
  exact mul_pos hpos hneg

name: Qsqrtd.norm_pos_of_forall_algHom_pos
statement:
theorem norm_pos_of_forall_algHom_pos (d : ℤ) (hd : 0 ≤ (d : ℝ))
    {z : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)}
    (hz : ∀ σ : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ) →ₐ[ℚ] ℝ, 0 < σ z) :
    0 < Qsqrtd.norm z
proof:
:= by
  have hsign :=
    (forall_algHom_pos_iff_realEmbeddingPos_and_realEmbeddingNeg_pos d hd z).mp hz
  have hnorm : 0 < (Qsqrtd.norm z : ℝ) :=
    norm_pos_of_realEmbedding_pos d hd hsign.1 hsign.2
  exact_mod_cast hnorm

name: Qsqrtd.ringHom_eval_eq_algHom_eval
statement:
theorem ringHom_eval_eq_algHom_eval
    (d : ℤ) [Fact (Squarefree d)] [Fact (d ≠ 1)]
    (σ : FractionRing (NumberField.RingOfIntegers (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ))) →+* ℝ)
    (w : FractionRing (NumberField.RingOfIntegers (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)))) :
    let R
proof:
:= NumberField.RingOfIntegers (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ))
    let e : FractionRing R ≃ₐ[R] Qsqrtd (d : ℚ) :=
      FractionRing.algEquiv R (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ))
  let φ : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ) →ₐ[ℚ] ℝ := (σ.comp e.symm.toRingHom).toRatAlgHom
  σ w = φ (e w) := by
  intro R e φ
  change σ w = σ (e.symm (e w))
  rw [e.symm_apply_apply]

name: Qsqrtd.fractionRing_ringHom_eq_realEmbeddingPos_or_neg
statement:
theorem fractionRing_ringHom_eq_realEmbeddingPos_or_neg
    (d : ℤ) [Fact (Squarefree d)] [Fact (d ≠ 1)] (hd : 0 ≤ (d : ℝ))
    (σ : FractionRing (NumberField.RingOfIntegers (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ))) →+* ℝ) :
    let R
proof:
:= NumberField.RingOfIntegers (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ))
    let e : FractionRing R ≃ₐ[R] Qsqrtd (d : ℚ) :=
      FractionRing.algEquiv R (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ))
    σ = (realEmbeddingPos d hd).toRingHom.comp e.toRingHom ∨
      σ = (realEmbeddingNeg d hd).toRingHom.comp e.toRingHom := by
  intro R e
  let φ : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ) →ₐ[ℚ] ℝ := (σ.comp e.symm.toRingHom).toRatAlgHom
  rcases algHom_eq_realEmbeddingPos_or_neg d hd φ with hφ | hφ
  · left
    ext w
    have heval := ringHom_eval_eq_algHom_eval d σ w
    change σ w = φ (e w) at heval
    rw [hφ] at heval
    simpa [RingHom.comp_apply] using heval
  · right
    ext w
    have heval := ringHom_eval_eq_algHom_eval d σ w
    change σ w = φ (e w) at heval
    rw [hφ] at heval
    simpa [RingHom.comp_apply] using heval

name: Qsqrtd.embedding_omega_sq
statement:
theorem embedding_omega_sq
    (v : NumberField.InfinitePlace (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ))) :
    v.embedding QuadraticAlgebra.omega ^ 2 = ((d : ℚ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sq, ← map_mul, QuadraticAlgebra.omega_mul_omega_eq_add]
  simp [Algebra.smul_def]

name: Qsqrtd.embedding_omega_sq_re
statement:
private theorem embedding_omega_sq_re
    (v : NumberField.InfinitePlace (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ))) :
    (v.embedding QuadraticAlgebra.omega).re ^ 2 -
    (v.embedding QuadraticAlgebra.omega).im ^ 2 = (d : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have := congr_arg Complex.re (embedding_omega_sq v)
  simp [sq, Complex.mul_re] at this; linarith

name: Qsqrtd.embedding_omega_sq_im
statement:
private theorem embedding_omega_sq_im
    (v : NumberField.InfinitePlace (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ))) :
    2 * (v.embedding QuadraticAlgebra.omega).re *
    (v.embedding QuadraticAlgebra.omega).im = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := congr_arg Complex.im (embedding_omega_sq v)
  simp [sq, Complex.mul_im] at this; linarith

name: Qsqrtd.embedding_omega_im_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem embedding_omega_im_eq_zero
    (v : NumberField.InfinitePlace (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)))
    (hd : 0 < d) :
    (v.embedding QuadraticAlgebra.omega).im = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hre := embedding_omega_sq_re v
  have him := embedding_omega_sq_im v
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp him with h | h
  · rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h with h | h
    · norm_num at h
    · rw [h] at hre; simp at hre
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (v.embedding QuadraticAlgebra.omega).im,
                 (show (d : ℝ) > 0 from by exact_mod_cast hd)]
  · exact h

name: Qsqrtd.conjugate_embedding_eq
statement:
private theorem conjugate_embedding_eq
    (v : NumberField.InfinitePlace (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)))
    (hω_im : (v.embedding QuadraticAlgebra.omega).im = 0) :
    NumberField.ComplexEmbedding.conjugate v.embedding = v.embedding
proof:
:= by
  rw [← @RingHom.toRatAlgHom_toRingHom (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) ℂ _ _ _ _
    (NumberField.ComplexEmbedding.conjugate v.embedding),
    ← @RingHom.toRatAlgHom_toRingHom (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) ℂ _ _ _ _
    v.embedding]
  congr 1
  apply QuadraticAlgebra.algHom_ext
  change (NumberField.ComplexEmbedding.conjugate v.embedding).toRatAlgHom
    QuadraticAlgebra.omega = v.embedding.toRatAlgHom QuadraticAlgebra.omega
  simp only [RingHom.toRatAlgHom_apply, NumberField.ComplexEmbedding.conjugate_coe_eq]
  exact Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mpr hω_im

name: Qsqrtd.isTotallyReal
statement:
theorem isTotallyReal (hd : 0 < d) :
    NumberField.IsTotallyReal (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ))

name: Qsqrtd.isTotallyComplex
statement:
theorem isTotallyComplex (hd : d < 0) :
    NumberField.IsTotallyComplex (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ))
proof:
:= {
    isComplex := fun v => by
      rw [NumberField.InfinitePlace.isComplex_iff, NumberField.ComplexEmbedding.isReal_iff]
      intro hreal
      have hω_real : (v.embedding QuadraticAlgebra.omega).im = 0 := by
        have h := RingHom.congr_fun hreal QuadraticAlgebra.omega
        simp only [NumberField.ComplexEmbedding.conjugate_coe_eq] at h
        exact Complex.conj_eq_iff_im.mp h
      have hre := embedding_omega_sq_re v
      rw [hω_real] at hre; simp at hre
      linarith [sq_nonneg (v.embedding QuadraticAlgebra.omega).re,
                (show (d : ℝ) < 0 from by exact_mod_cast hd)]
  }

name: Qsqrtd.isCMField
statement:
theorem isCMField (hd : d < 0) :
    NumberField.IsCMField (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  letI := isTotallyComplex d hd
  exact NumberField.IsCMField.ofCMExtension ℚ (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ))

name: Qsqrtd.nrComplexPlaces_eq_one_of_neg
statement:
theorem nrComplexPlaces_eq_one_of_neg (hd : d < 0) :
    NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrComplexPlaces (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isTotallyComplex d hd
  have hfin := finrank_ratAlgebra_eq_two (d : ℚ)
  have hc := NumberField.IsTotallyComplex.finrank (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ))
  have h : 2 = 2 * NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrComplexPlaces (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) :=
    hfin.symm.trans hc
  omega

name: Qsqrtd.nrComplexPlaces_eq_zero_of_pos
statement:
theorem nrComplexPlaces_eq_zero_of_pos (hd : 0 < d) :
    NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrComplexPlaces (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isTotallyReal d hd
  exact NumberField.IsTotallyReal.nrComplexPlaces_eq_zero (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ))

name: QuadraticField.isTotallyReal_of_algEquiv_qsqrtd
statement:
theorem isTotallyReal_of_algEquiv_qsqrtd
    (e : K ≃ₐ[ℚ] Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) (hd : 0 < d) :
    NumberField.IsTotallyReal K
proof:
:=
  (NumberField.isTotallyReal_iff_ofAlgEquiv e).mpr (Qsqrtd.isTotallyReal d hd)

name: QuadraticField.isTotallyComplex_of_algEquiv_qsqrtd
statement:
theorem isTotallyComplex_of_algEquiv_qsqrtd
    (e : K ≃ₐ[ℚ] Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) (hd : d < 0) :
    NumberField.IsTotallyComplex K
proof:
:=
  (NumberField.isTotallyComplex_iff_ofAlgEquiv e).mpr (Qsqrtd.isTotallyComplex d hd)

name: QuadraticField.exists_totallyReal_or_totallyComplex
statement:
theorem exists_totallyReal_or_totallyComplex
    (K : Type*) [Field K] [Algebra ℚ K] [QuadraticField K] :
    ∃ d : ℤ, Squarefree d ∧ d ≠ 1 ∧ Nonempty (K ≃ₐ[ℚ] Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) ∧
      ((0 < d ∧ NumberField.IsTotallyReal K) ∨
      (d < 0 ∧ NumberField.IsTotallyComplex K))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd_sf, hd_ne, ⟨e⟩⟩ := exists_algEquiv_qsqrtd K
  letI : Fact (Squarefree d) := ⟨hd_sf⟩
  letI : Fact (d ≠ 1) := ⟨hd_ne⟩
  rcases lt_trichotomy d 0 with hd_neg | hd_zero | hd_pos
  · exact ⟨d, hd_sf, hd_ne, ⟨e⟩,
      Or.inr ⟨hd_neg, isTotallyComplex_of_algEquiv_qsqrtd d e hd_neg⟩⟩
  · exact False.elim (Squarefree.ne_zero hd_sf hd_zero)
  · exact ⟨d, hd_sf, hd_ne, ⟨e⟩,
      Or.inl ⟨hd_pos, isTotallyReal_of_algEquiv_qsqrtd d e hd_pos⟩⟩

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.TraceNorm.Qsqrtd.add_star_eq_trace_image
statement:
theorem add_star_eq_trace_image {d : ℤ} (x : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) :
    x + star x =
      algebraMap ℚ (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) (Algebra.trace ℚ (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) x)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  · simp [Qsqrtd.trace_eq_re_add_re_star, star]
  · simp [star]

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.TraceNorm.Qsqrtd.norm_image_eq_mul_star
statement:
theorem norm_image_eq_mul_star {d : ℤ} (x : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) :
    algebraMap ℚ (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) (Qsqrtd.norm x) = x * star x
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Qsqrtd.norm, mul_comm] using
    (QuadraticAlgebra.algebraMap_norm_eq_mul_star (a := (d : ℚ)) (b := (0 : ℚ)) x)

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.TraceNorm.isIntegral_star
statement:
private lemma isIntegral_star {d : ℤ} {x : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)} (hx : IsIntegral ℤ x) :
    IsIntegral ℤ (star x)
proof:
:=
  map_isIntegral_int (starRingEnd (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ))) hx

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.TraceNorm.norm_eq_sqr_minus_d_sqr
statement:
theorem norm_eq_sqr_minus_d_sqr {d : ℤ} (x : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) :
    Qsqrtd.norm x = x.re ^ 2 - (d : ℚ) * x.im ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [Qsqrtd.norm, QuadraticAlgebra.norm]
  ring

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.TraceNorm.isIntegral_trace_image
statement:
private lemma isIntegral_trace_image {d : ℤ} {x : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)} (hx : IsIntegral ℤ x) :
    IsIntegral ℤ (algebraMap ℚ (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) (Algebra.trace ℚ (Qsqrtd d) x))
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Qsqrtd.add_star_eq_trace_image x] using hx.add (isIntegral_star hx)

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.TraceNorm.isIntegral_trace
statement:
private lemma isIntegral_trace {d : ℤ} {x : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)} (hx : IsIntegral ℤ x) :
    IsIntegral ℤ (Algebra.trace ℚ (Qsqrtd d) x)
proof:
:=
  (isIntegral_algHom_iff (algebraMap ℚ (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ))).toIntAlgHom
    (algebraMap ℚ (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ))).injective).1 (isIntegral_trace_image hx)

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.TraceNorm.exists_int_trace
statement:
lemma exists_int_trace {d : ℤ} {x : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)} (hx : IsIntegral ℤ x) :
    ∃ a' : ℤ, (a' : ℚ) = Algebra.trace ℚ (Qsqrtd d) x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := (IsIntegrallyClosed.isIntegral_iff (R := ℤ) (K := ℚ)).1
    (isIntegral_trace hx)
  exact ⟨a', by simpa using ha'⟩

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.TraceNorm.isIntegral_norm_image
statement:
private lemma isIntegral_norm_image {d : ℤ} {x : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)} (hx : IsIntegral ℤ x) :
    IsIntegral ℤ (algebraMap ℚ (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)) (Qsqrtd.norm x))
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Qsqrtd.norm_image_eq_mul_star x] using hx.mul (isIntegral_star hx)

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.TraceNorm.isIntegral_norm
statement:
private lemma isIntegral_norm {d : ℤ} {x : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)} (hx : IsIntegral ℤ x) :
    IsIntegral ℤ (Qsqrtd.norm x)
proof:
:=
  (isIntegral_algHom_iff (algebraMap ℚ (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ))).toIntAlgHom
    (algebraMap ℚ (Qsqrtd (d : ℚ))).injective).1 (isIntegral_norm_image hx)

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.TraceNorm.exists_int_norm
statement:
lemma exists_int_norm {d : ℤ} {x : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)} (hx : IsIntegral ℤ x) :
    ∃ n' : ℤ, (n' : ℚ) = Qsqrtd.norm x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n', hn'⟩ := (IsIntegrallyClosed.isIntegral_iff (R := ℤ) (K := ℚ)).1
    (isIntegral_norm hx)
  exact ⟨n', by simpa using hn'⟩

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.TraceNorm.re_eq_half_trace_int
proof:
:= by
  nlinarith [show 2 * x.re = (a' : ℚ) by
    calc
      2 * x.re = Algebra.trace ℚ (Qsqrtd d) x := (Qsqrtd.trace_eq_two_re x).symm
      _ = (a' : ℚ) := ha'trace.symm]

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.TraceNorm.isIntegral_of_sq_int
statement:
lemma isIntegral_of_sq_int {q : ℚ} {k : ℤ} (hq2 : q ^ 2 = (k : ℚ)) :
    IsIntegral ℤ q
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Polynomial.X ^ 2 - Polynomial.C k,
    Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C (R := ℤ) (n := 2) k (by decide), ?_⟩
  rw [Polynomial.eval₂_sub, Polynomial.eval₂_pow, Polynomial.eval₂_X, Polynomial.eval₂_C]
  simp [hq2]

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.TraceNorm.double_im_sq_mul_eq
statement:
private lemma double_im_sq_mul_eq
    (d : ℤ) {x : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)} {a' n' : ℤ}
    (ha'trace : (a' : ℚ) = Algebra.trace ℚ (Qsqrtd d) x)
    (hn'norm : (n' : ℚ) = Qsqrtd.norm x) :
    (d : ℚ) * (2 * x.im) ^ 2 = (a' ^ 2 - 4 * n' : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hre : x.re = (a' : ℚ) / 2 := re_eq_half_trace_int ha'trace
  have hnorm' :
      (n' : ℚ) = ((a' : ℚ) / 2) ^ 2 - (d : ℚ) * x.im ^ 2 := by
    calc
      (n' : ℚ) = Qsqrtd.norm x := hn'norm
      _ = x.re ^ 2 - (d : ℚ) * x.im ^ 2 := norm_eq_sqr_minus_d_sqr x
      _ = ((a' : ℚ) / 2) ^ 2 - (d : ℚ) * x.im ^ 2 := by simp [hre]
  have haux : (a' : ℚ) ^ 2 - 4 * (n' : ℚ) = 4 * (d : ℚ) * x.im ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hnorm']
  have hmcast : ((a' ^ 2 - 4 * n' : ℤ) : ℚ) = (a' : ℚ) ^ 2 - 4 * (n' : ℚ) := by
    norm_cast
  calc
    (d : ℚ) * (2 * x.im) ^ 2 = 4 * (d : ℚ) * x.im ^ 2 := by ring
    _ = (a' : ℚ) ^ 2 - 4 * (n' : ℚ) := by linarith [haux]
    _ = (a' ^ 2 - 4 * n' : ℤ) := hmcast.symm

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.TraceNorm.double_im_sq_eq_ratio
statement:
private lemma double_im_sq_eq_ratio
    (d : ℤ) (hd0Q : (d : ℚ) ≠ 0) {x : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)} {a' n' : ℤ}
    (ha'trace : (a' : ℚ) = Algebra.trace ℚ (Qsqrtd d) x)
    (hn'norm : (n' : ℚ) = Qsqrtd.norm x) :
    (2 * x.im) ^ 2 = (a' ^ 2 - 4 * n' : ℤ) / (d : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (2 * x.im) ^ 2 = ((d : ℚ) * (2 * x.im) ^ 2) / (d : ℚ) := by field_simp [hd0Q]
    _ = (a' ^ 2 - 4 * n' : ℤ) / (d : ℚ) := by
      simp [double_im_sq_mul_eq d ha'trace hn'norm]

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.TraceNorm.isSquare_trace_norm_ratio
statement:
private lemma isSquare_trace_norm_ratio
    (d : ℤ) (hd0Q : (d : ℚ) ≠ 0) {x : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)} {a' n' : ℤ}
    (ha'trace : (a' : ℚ) = Algebra.trace ℚ (Qsqrtd d) x)
    (hn'norm : (n' : ℚ) = Qsqrtd.norm x) :
    IsSquare ((a' ^ 2 - 4 * n' : ℤ) / (d : ℚ))
proof:
:=
  ⟨2 * x.im, by simpa [pow_two] using (double_im_sq_eq_ratio d hd0Q ha'trace hn'norm).symm⟩

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.TraceNorm.dvd_trace_norm_delta
statement:
private lemma dvd_trace_norm_delta
    (d : ℤ) (hd0 : d ≠ 0) (hd_sf : Squarefree d) (hd0Q : (d : ℚ) ≠ 0)
    {x : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)} {a' n' : ℤ}
    (ha'trace : (a' : ℚ) = Algebra.trace ℚ (Qsqrtd d) x)
    (hn'norm : (n' : ℚ) = Qsqrtd.norm x) :
    d ∣ (a' ^ 2 - 4 * n')
proof:
:=
  int_dvd_of_ratio_square (a' ^ 2 - 4 * n') d hd0 hd_sf
    (isSquare_trace_norm_ratio d hd0Q ha'trace hn'norm)

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.TraceNorm.double_im_sq_eq_int
statement:
private lemma double_im_sq_eq_int
    (d : ℤ) (hd0Q : (d : ℚ) ≠ 0) {x : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)} {a' n' k : ℤ}
    (hk : a' ^ 2 - 4 * n' = d * k)
    (ha'trace : (a' : ℚ) = Algebra.trace ℚ (Qsqrtd d) x)
    (hn'norm : (n' : ℚ) = Qsqrtd.norm x) :
    (2 * x.im) ^ 2 = (k : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  have hmk : ((a' ^ 2 - 4 * n' : ℤ) : ℚ) = (d : ℚ) * k := by
    exact_mod_cast hk
  calc
    (2 * x.im) ^ 2 = (a' ^ 2 - 4 * n' : ℤ) / (d : ℚ) :=
      double_im_sq_eq_ratio d hd0Q ha'trace hn'norm
    _ = ((d : ℚ) * k) / (d : ℚ) := by simp [hmk]
    _ = (k : ℚ) := by field_simp [hd0Q]

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.TraceNorm.exists_int_of_isIntegral_rat
statement:
private lemma exists_int_of_isIntegral_rat {q : ℚ} (hq : IsIntegral ℤ q) :
    ∃ b' : ℤ, (b' : ℚ) = q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b', hb'⟩ := (IsIntegrallyClosed.isIntegral_iff (R := ℤ) (K := ℚ)).1 hq
  exact ⟨b', by simpa using hb'⟩

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.TraceNorm.im_eq_half_of_double_im_eq
proof:
:= by
  nlinarith [hb']

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.TraceNorm.exists_int_double_im
statement:
lemma exists_int_double_im
    (d : ℤ) (hd_sf : Squarefree d) {x : Qsqrtd (d : ℚ)} {a' n' : ℤ}
    (ha'trace : (a' : ℚ) = Algebra.trace ℚ (Qsqrtd d) x)
    (hn'norm : (n' : ℚ) = Qsqrtd.norm x) :
    ∃ b' : ℤ, x.im = (b' : ℚ) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hd0 : d ≠ 0 := hd_sf.ne_zero
  have hd0Q : (d : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast hd0
  rcases dvd_trace_norm_delta d hd0 hd_sf hd0Q ha'trace hn'norm with ⟨k, hk⟩
  rcases exists_int_of_isIntegral_rat
      (isIntegral_of_sq_int (double_im_sq_eq_int d hd0Q hk ha'trace hn'norm)) with
    ⟨b', hb'⟩
  exact ⟨b', im_eq_half_of_double_im_eq hb'⟩

name: QuadraticNumberFields.RingOfIntegers.TraceNorm.dvd_four_sub_sq_of_norm_eq_int
statement:
lemma dvd_four_sub_sq_of_norm_eq_int
    (a' b' d n' : ℤ)
    (hnorm :
      (n' : ℚ) = (((a' ^ 2 - d * b' ^ 2 : ℤ) : ℚ) / (4 : ℤ))) :
    (4 : ℤ) ∣ (a' ^ 2 - d * b' ^ 2)
proof:
:=

name: QuadraticNumberFields.Splitting.splitting_classification_kronecker_formula
statement:
private theorem splitting_classification_kronecker_formula (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    (kroneckerSymNat (RingOfIntegers.discrFormula d) p = 1 ∧
      e(p) = 1 ∧ f(p) = 1) ∨
    (kroneckerSymNat (RingOfIntegers.discrFormula d) p = -1 ∧
      g(p) = 1 ∧ e(p) = 1) ∨
    (kroneckerSymNat (RingOfIntegers.discrFormula d) p = 0 ∧ 1 < e(p))
proof:
:= by
  rcases splitting_classification d p with ⟨hcond, hef⟩ | ⟨hcond, hge⟩ | ⟨hcond, he⟩
  · refine Or.inl ⟨?_, hef⟩
    rcases hcond with ⟨rfl, hd8⟩ | ⟨hp2, -, hleg⟩
    · have hd4 : d % 4 = 1 := by omega
      have hD8 : RingOfIntegers.discrFormula d % 8 = 1 := by
        rw [RingOfIntegers.discrFormula_of_mod_four_eq_one hd4]
        exact hd8
      rw [kroneckerSymNat_two]
      exact (kroneckerTwo_eq_one_iff (RingOfIntegers.discrFormula d)).mpr (Or.inl hD8)
    · rw [kroneckerSymNat_discFormula_eq_legendreSym_param_of_ne_two d hp2]
      exact hleg
  · refine Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨?_, hge⟩)
    rcases hcond with ⟨rfl, hd8⟩ | ⟨hp2, -, hleg⟩
    · have hd4 : d % 4 = 1 := by omega
      have hD8 : RingOfIntegers.discrFormula d % 8 = 5 := by
        rw [RingOfIntegers.discrFormula_of_mod_four_eq_one hd4]
        exact hd8
      rw [kroneckerSymNat_two]
      exact (kroneckerTwo_eq_neg_one_iff (RingOfIntegers.discrFormula d)).mpr
        (Or.inr hD8)
    · rw [kroneckerSymNat_discFormula_eq_legendreSym_param_of_ne_two d hp2]
      exact hleg
  · refine Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨?_, he⟩)
    rcases hcond with ⟨rfl, hd4⟩ | ⟨hp2, hpd⟩
    · have hD2 : RingOfIntegers.discrFormula d % 2 = 0 := by
        rw [RingOfIntegers.discrFormula_of_mod_four_ne_one hd4]
        omega
      rw [kroneckerSymNat_two]
      exact (kroneckerTwo_eq_zero_iff (RingOfIntegers.discrFormula d)).mpr hD2
    · rw [kroneckerSymNat_discFormula_eq_legendreSym_param_of_ne_two d hp2]
      exact (legendreSym.eq_zero_iff p d).mpr ((ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd d p).mpr hpd)

statement:
private theorem splitting_classification_kronecker_discr (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    (kroneckerSymNat (disc(d)) p = 1 ∧ e(p) = 1 ∧ f(p) = 1) ∨
    (kroneckerSymNat (disc(d)) p = -1 ∧ g(p) = 1 ∧ e(p) = 1) ∨
    (kroneckerSymNat (disc(d)) p = 0 ∧ 1 < e(p))
proof:
:= by
  rw [RingOfIntegers.discr_formula d]
  exact splitting_classification_kronecker_formula d p

name: QuadraticNumberFields.Splitting.isSplit_iff_kroneckerSymNat_discr_eq_one
statement:
theorem isSplit_iff_kroneckerSymNat_discr_eq_one (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    Ideal.IsSplitIn (𝔭(p)) 𝓞(d) ↔ kroneckerSymNat (disc(d)) p = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hchar : ringChar ℤ ≠ 2 := by simp [ringChar.eq_zero]
  have hbot : 𝔭(p) ≠ ⊥ := by
    rw [Ne, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot, Nat.cast_eq_zero]
    exact (Fact.out : Nat.Prime p).ne_zero
  haveI : (𝔭(p)).IsMaximal :=
    PrincipalIdealRing.isMaximal_of_irreducible
      ((Nat.prime_iff_prime_int.mp (Fact.out : Nat.Prime p)).irreducible)
  constructor
  · intro hsplit
    have hgef := (Ideal.ramificationIdxIn_eq_one_and_inertiaDegIn_eq_one_iff_efg
      (𝔭(p)) 𝓞(d) hchar hbot).mp hsplit
    rcases splitting_classification_kronecker_discr d p with
      ⟨hk, -, -⟩ | ⟨-, hg, -⟩ | ⟨-, he⟩
    · exact hk
    · omega
    · omega
  · intro hk
    rcases splitting_classification_kronecker_discr d p with
      ⟨-, he, hf⟩ | ⟨hk', -, -⟩ | ⟨hk', -⟩
    · exact ⟨he, hf⟩
    · omega
    · omega

name: QuadraticNumberFields.Splitting.isInert_iff_kroneckerSymNat_discr_eq_neg_one
statement:
theorem isInert_iff_kroneckerSymNat_discr_eq_neg_one (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    Ideal.IsInertIn (𝔭(p)) 𝓞(d) ↔ kroneckerSymNat (disc(d)) p = -1
proof:
:= by
  have hchar : ringChar ℤ ≠ 2 := by simp [ringChar.eq_zero]
  have hbot : 𝔭(p) ≠ ⊥ := by
    rw [Ne, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot, Nat.cast_eq_zero]
    exact (Fact.out : Nat.Prime p).ne_zero
  haveI : (𝔭(p)).IsMaximal :=
    PrincipalIdealRing.isMaximal_of_irreducible
      ((Nat.prime_iff_prime_int.mp (Fact.out : Nat.Prime p)).irreducible)
  constructor
  · intro hinert
    have hgef := (Ideal.ncard_primesOver_eq_one_and_ramificationIdxIn_eq_one_iff_efg
      (𝔭(p)) 𝓞(d) hchar hbot).mp hinert
    rcases splitting_classification_kronecker_discr d p with
      ⟨-, -, hf⟩ | ⟨hk, -, -⟩ | ⟨-, he⟩
    · omega
    · exact hk
    · omega
  · intro hk
    rcases splitting_classification_kronecker_discr d p with
      ⟨hk', -, -⟩ | ⟨-, hg, he⟩ | ⟨hk', -⟩
    · omega
    · exact ⟨hg, he⟩
    · omega

name: QuadraticNumberFields.Splitting.isRamified_iff_kroneckerSymNat_discr_eq_zero
statement:
theorem isRamified_iff_kroneckerSymNat_discr_eq_zero (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    Ideal.IsRamifiedIn (𝔭(p)) 𝓞(d) ↔ kroneckerSymNat (disc(d)) p = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hram
    have he : 1 < e(p) := hram
    rcases splitting_classification_kronecker_discr d p with
      ⟨-, he', -⟩ | ⟨-, -, he'⟩ | ⟨hk, -⟩
    · omega
    · omega
    · exact hk
  · intro hk
    rcases splitting_classification_kronecker_discr d p with
      ⟨hk', -, -⟩ | ⟨hk', -, -⟩ | ⟨-, he⟩
    · omega
    · omega
    · exact he

name: QuadraticNumberFields.Splitting.absNorm_eq_prime_of_liesOver_of_isSplitIn
statement:
theorem absNorm_eq_prime_of_liesOver_of_isSplitIn
    (p : ℕ)
    {P : Ideal 𝓞(d)} [P.IsPrime] [P.LiesOver 𝔭(p)]
    (hs : Ideal.IsSplitIn (𝔭(p)) 𝓞(d)) :
    Ideal.absNorm P = p
proof:
:= by

  rw [Ideal.inertiaDeg_eq_one_of_isSplitIn (p := 𝔭(p)) (S := 𝓞(d)) hchar hs]

statement:

statement:

proof:
